item.title: Trump comprou ações da SpaceX, de Elon Musk, em junho
item.description: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, investiu até US$50.000 na SpaceX, de Elon Musk, em junho, mostrou declaração financeira pública, o que lhe conferiu participação financeira em uma importante empresa contratada pelo governo que é dirigida por um ex-assessor.
item.dc:creator: Courtney Rozen
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, investiu até US$50.000 na SpaceX, de Elon Musk, em junho, mostrou declaração financeira pública, o que lhe conferiu participação financeira em uma importante empresa contratada pelo governo que é dirigida por um ex-assessor. Ele comprou entre US$15.001 e US$50.000 em ações em 23 de junho, de acordo com uma declaração financeira assinada por ele em 12 de agosto, tornada pública em 22 de agosto. A compra fez parte de mais de 1.000 transações com ações realizadas pelo presidente em junho. A SpaceX realizou sua oferta pública inicial (IPO) em 12 de junho, batendo todos os recordes de IPO. Em comunicado à Reuters, o porta-voz da Casa Branca, Davis Ingle, afirmou que instituições financeiras terceirizadas administram de forma independente a carteira do presidente e replicam “índices reconhecidos, como o Schwab 1000”. “Nem o presidente Trump nem qualquer membro de sua família tem qualquer capacidade de orientar, influenciar ou dar sugestões sobre como a carteira é investida ou quando os investimentos são comprados ou vendidos”, disse Ingle no comunicado. O investimento de Trump na SpaceX cria um novo vínculo financeiro entre o presidente e a empresa de foguetes de Musk, em um momento em que o governo analisa decisões que podem afetar o futuro da empresa. A SpaceX é uma contratada das Forças Armadas dos EUA e frequentemente busca aprovações de órgãos federais. Na última quinta-feira, Trump instruiu sua equipe a aumentar drasticamente o número de lançamentos espaciais comerciais dos EUA. A SpaceX é uma empresa dominante nesse setor. A Reuters não conseguiu determinar imediatamente o valor exato do investimento, pois as autoridades federais utilizam faixas de valores para declarar o valor de seus ativos nos formulários de declaração financeira.

item.title: Durigan defende controle da “pejotização” e revisão de tributos de empresas em novo mandato de Lula
item.description: O ministro da Fazenda, Dario Durigan, disse nesta segunda-feira que sua equipe avalia mecanismos de controle da chamada “pejotização” em um eventual novo mandato do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva para minimizar o déficit previdenciário do país, defendendo também uma revisão de tributos cobrados hoje de empresas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O ministro da Fazenda, Dario Durigan, disse nesta segunda-feira que sua equipe avalia mecanismos de controle da chamada “pejotização” em um eventual novo mandato do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva para minimizar o déficit previdenciário do país, defendendo também uma revisão de tributos cobrados hoje de empresas. Em entrevista ao Broadcast, da Agência Estado, Durigan afirmou que poderia haver uma regra relacionada ao percentual de contratos de pessoa jurídica (PJ) feitos por uma empresa em detrimento dos contratos CLT. “Uma empresa que tem 80% da sua força de trabalho pejotizada, eventualmente você pode ter que obrigar essa empresa a ter uma contribuição previdenciária para nivelar e poder oferecer a esses 80% dos seus trabalhadores um futuro um pouco mais protegido do ponto de vista de seguridade social”, afirmou. Durigan afirmou ser preciso reconhecer que o país tem um “déficit previdenciário importante”, ressaltando a necessidade de combater privilégios. Ele usou como exemplo a previdência de militares, que já foi alvo de proposta de ajuste pelo atual governo, mas o projeto não foi aprovado pelo Congresso. O ministro se pronunciou na entrevista como representante da campanha do presidente Lula, que buscará a reeleição no pleito de outubro. Sem entrar em detalhes, Durigan também disse que é “preciso fazer uma revisão da tributação empresarial, seja discutindo a tributação da folha de pagamento, seja discutindo a tributação do chamado JCP (Juros sobre o Capital Próprio).” Ele ainda defendeu a introdução de mecanismos que priorizem a contribuição tributária efetiva de empresas, não a nominal. “Não importa qual regime você vai estar, você tem uma contribuição efetiva que, via de regra, é muito menor do que a contribuição nominal que já está prevista na lei, de modo a otimizar e racionalizar o sistema tributário”, afirmou.

item.title: Mike McCarthy: Steelers at contract 'impasse' with CB Joey Porter Jr.
item.description: While eight-time Pro Bowl cornerback Jalen Ramsey came off the physically unable to perform list on Monday, another Pittsburgh Steelers cornerback remains on the PUP list with no end to that stint in sight.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: While eight-time Pro Bowl cornerback Jalen Ramsey came off the physically unable to perform list on Monday, another Pittsburgh Steelers cornerback remains on the PUP list with no end to that stint in sight. Steelers coach Mike McCarthy told reporters that the team is currently "at an impasse" with cornerback Joey Porter Jr., who is sidelined after aggravating a back injury on the first day of Pittsburgh's training camp. Porter, 26, is entering the final year of his rookie contract after the Steelers took him with the first pick of the second round (32nd overall) in the 2023 NFL Draft. Before sustaining the injury setback, Porter was present at the team's OTA and mandatory minicamp workouts but was not observed participating during the portions media members were allowed to observe. Asked for a timeline of when he would want to see Porter on the practice field in order to play him in the Steelers' regular-season opener vs. Atlanta on Sept. 13, McCarthy didn't give a specific answer, instead deferring to the uniqueness of this situation. "I learned this in my early years as a head coach: You have to separate the business and football," McCarthy said. "Sometimes it's easier than others. This is a challenge for both Joey and us because we're first-year staff. We've seen them play, compete against Joey. "I would love the opportunity to coach Joey Porter. I know our defensive guys would love the opportunity. So, we're at an impasse right here, and you've got to respect that. Every one of us has a contract. The organization, they have beliefs and so forth. But yeah, that's just kind of where we are." Porter has amassed 165 tackles, 31 pass breakups, three interceptions, three tackles for loss and one sack over 47 regular-season games (41 starts) over his first three seasons with Pittsburgh. --Field Level Media

item.title: Putin autoriza Rússia a assumir controle de infraestruturas consideradas vulneráveis a ataques de drones
item.description: O presidente Vladimir Putin concedeu, nesta segunda-feira, ao Estado russo o poder de assumir o controle de infraestruturas de importância crítica, caso se considere que elas estejam mal protegidas contra ataques de drones ucranianos e outras ameaças.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente Vladimir Putin concedeu, nesta segunda-feira, ao Estado russo o poder de assumir o controle de infraestruturas de importância crítica, caso se considere que elas estejam mal protegidas contra ataques de drones ucranianos e outras ameaças. Os poderes especiais, estabelecidos em um decreto presidencial, permitirão que o Estado assuma a administração temporária dessas instalações, em um momento em que a Ucrânia intensificou os ataques com drones a refinarias de petróleo e depósitos de varejo. O Estado poderá assumir o controle de ativos físicos e financeiros, bem como dos direitos formais de propriedade, caso se determine que as entidades responsáveis por tais instalações tenham falhado em seu dever de protegê-las e demorem demais para repará-las após qualquer ataque, de acordo com o decreto. Isso se aplica a instalações de combustível, energia, indústria, comunicações, transporte e logística, bem como a outros objetos considerados de importância crítica para garantir a segurança e a estabilidade econômica do Estado e da população. O primeiro vice-primeiro-ministro, Denis Manturov, afirmou que a medida não deve ser vista como um precursor da nacionalização e não será utilizada em grande escala. “Isso não envolve nacionalização nem mudança de propriedade. O decreto prevê que o Estado participe da gestão de uma empresa a fim de resolver questões específicas de segurança”, disse Manturov, segundo a Interfax. Na semana passada, Putin ordenou que o governo lançasse um programa para reconstruir depósitos comerciais danificados ou destruídos pela Ucrânia nas últimas semanas. Desde 18 de julho, Kiev atacou pelo menos duas dúzias de depósitos pertencentes à Wildberries, a maior varejista online da Rússia, destruindo grande parte de sua capacidade de armazenamento. Na segunda-feira, a Ozon , segunda maior varejista online da Rússia, informou que quatro de seus centros logísticos no sul da Rússia foram alvo de ataques ucranianos.

item.title: Sky to shift focus toward future in matchup against Sun
item.description: The Chicago Sky were eliminated from postseason contention in their most recent game, but not without a fight until running out of gas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Chicago Sky were eliminated from postseason contention in their most recent game, but not without a fight until running out of gas. After seeing their three-game winning streak come to a halt, the Sky (15-23) will look to get back on track Tuesday when they visit the Connecticut Sun (9-27) in Uncasville, Conn. Natasha Cloud scored 16 points in Chicago's 113-90 setback to the Indiana Fever on Sunday. She also got into a heated verbal exchange with Enes Kanter Freedom that led to the former NBA player being ejected from a courtside seat. Azura Stevens had 14 points and rookie Aicha Coulibaly added 12 on 5-of-5 shooting from the floor. "I don't think anybody in the locker room is ready to mail it in," Sky head coach Tyler Marsh said. "We all understand we got a job to do. We got an organization and city to continue to play for. We got a lot of young players that still have time to continue to develop. We're not just playing for the right now, we're playing for the future too." Kamilla Cardoso, who boasts team-best averages in points (14.7) and rebounds (8.8), contributed 16 and 14, respectively, in Chicago's 92-63 loss at Connecticut on June 22. She added 26 points in the Sky's 94-88 victory over the Sun on July 30. Connecticut fell for the ninth time in its last 11 games on Saturday with a 77-68 setback to the Los Angeles Sparks. The Sparks scored 32 points in the first quarter then shifted to a defensive mindset, much to the chagrin of Connecticut head coach Rachid Meziane. "I didn't really like how our starting five came out tonight," Meziane said. "We didn't start the game with the right defensive energy. ... Yeah, I was a little surprised because the last five games we really (started well)." Saniya Rivers had 14 points and matched a career high with four steals for the Sun, who were held to 35.1% shooting but did force 25 turnovers that led to 30 points. Connecticut's Brittney Griner has missed four consecutive contests due to a left knee injury. She posted team-high point totals in two of the three meetings versus Chicago. --Field Level Media

item.title: Law firm Paul Weiss taps new Supreme Court practice head after Shanmugam exit
item.description: Law firm Paul Weiss has hired William Jay to lead its Supreme Court and appellate litigation practice, filling the role after the group's prominent head Kannon Shanmugam left for another firm earlier this year.
item.dc:creator: Sara Merken
item.content:encoded: Law firm Paul Weiss has hired William Jay to lead its Supreme Court and appellate litigation practice, filling the role after the group's prominent head Kannon Shanmugam left for another firm earlier this year. Jay, who has argued 19 cases before the U.S. Supreme Court, joins Paul Weiss as a Washington, D.C.-based partner, the firm said on Monday. He has represented clients including Teva Pharmaceuticals, Varsity Brands and B&B Hardware. Shanmugam, who previously led the Supreme Court practice at Paul Weiss, [USN:L6N4161HM TEXT:"departed"] with Masha Hansford in April to launch a new practice at law firm Davis Polk. Jay practiced at Goodwin for 14 years. He previously worked as an assistant to the Solicitor General. Earlier in his career he was a clerk to former U.S. Supreme Court Justice Antonin Scalia. Jay told Reuters that he was eager to join Paul Weiss as the New York firm grows its litigation department. Paul Weiss has hired a handful of litigation partners this year, including former U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission deputy enforcement director Antonia Apps in February. The firm has also seen litigator departures, including a pair of partners who joined Linklaters in July.

item.title: US include 35-year-old rookie Duncan among Solheim Cup captain's picks
item.description: U.S. Solheim Cup skipper Angela Stanford leaned heavily on experience by naming Megan Khang, Rose Zhang and Lindy Duncan as her three captain's picks on Monday for the team that will look to retain the trophy they took from Europe two years ago.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: U.S. Solheim Cup skipper Angela Stanford leaned heavily on experience by naming Megan Khang, Rose Zhang and Lindy Duncan as her three captain's picks on Monday for the team that will look to retain the trophy they took from Europe two years ago. Khang will be competing in her fifth consecutive Solheim Cup, Zhang will wear the red, white and blue for a third time while Duncan, at 35 the oldest member in the squad, is making her debut in the biennial matchplay competition. "Nothing can compare to the Solheim Cup ... putting on the red, white and blue is such an honor," Khang, who was top scorer for the U.S. at the 2023 Solheim Cup in Spain, said after being announced as the first of three captain's picks. Duncan, who joins Auston Kim as one of two rookies on the U.S. team, had held the second qualifying spot via the world rankings for nearly two months before dropping out of position after The Standard Portland Classic in mid-August. In addition to being the oldest member on the team, Duncan is the oldest debutant since Nancy Scranton played her first match aged 39 in 2000. Zhang had arguably one of the most dominant performances in the history of the Solheim Cup in 2024 when she went 4-0-0 in matches that never made it to the 17th hole. The trio joined automatic qualifiers Nelly Korda, Angel Yin, Jennifer Kupcho, Yealimi Noh, Auston Kim, Lauren Coughlin, Allisen Corpuz, Andrea Lee and Alison Lee on the U.S. team for the September 11 to 13 event at Bernardus Golf in the Netherlands. The U.S. squad are looking to retain the Solheim Cup and secure their first away victory since the 2015 edition.

item.title: Wisconsin high school QB dies from injuries sustained in game
item.description: A high school quarterback in Wisconsin died following injuries sustained during a game, according to the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A high school quarterback in Wisconsin died following injuries sustained during a game, according to the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel. Adam Massman, a senior at Lincoln High School in Alma Center, Wis., died after a game Thursday against Turtle Lake, per the report. District superintendent Drew Semingson sent a letter to Lincoln HS families informing them of the tragedy. "Adam was active in our Lincoln community, participating in multiple sports, clubs, and activities making friends everywhere he went," Semingson said in the statement. "This loss touches our Lincoln family in many ways. Adam's family has deep connections throughout our schools." Emergency personnel were on site at the game and Massman was taken to the hospital. Semingson did not provide any details about the nature of the injuries. The school will be open Monday and Tuesday to students, parents and friends wishing to meet with counselors. Massman also played varsity baseball and basketball at Lincoln. --Field Level Media

item.title: Cheniere confirms Corpus Christi LNG plant undergoing maintenance
item.description: U.S. LNG producer Cheniere Energy's Corpus Christi LNG export plant in Texas continued to show reduced natural gas demand on Monday, according to preliminary data from financial firm LSEG, as maintenance work at the facility continues.
item.dc:creator: Curtis Williams
item.content:encoded: U.S. LNG producer Cheniere Energy's (LNG.N) Corpus Christi LNG export plant in Texas continued to show reduced natural gas demand on Monday, according to preliminary data from financial firm LSEG, as maintenance work at the facility continues. Corpus Christi was on track to consume about 1.8 billion cubic feet per day (bcfd) of natural gas, down from its typical intake of around 2.6 bcfd. Corpus Christi is the United States' third-largest LNG export facility, while Cheniere is the largest LNG exporter. Cheniere said its Corpus Christi plant was undergoing planned maintenance but declined to give further details. Feedgas deliveries to all U.S. LNG export plants totaled about 16.7 bcfd on Monday, below the nearly 18 bcfd the country's LNG facilities can process. The U.S. is the world's largest LNG exporter and a key supplier of the supercooled fuel to global markets. The reduction in feedgas flows comes as global LNG markets remain supported by supply concerns linked to the ongoing conflict involving Iran.

item.title: Playboy fights fee bid in dispute with ex-lawyers at Quinn Emanuel
item.description: Playboy Enterprises and Quinn Emanuel are locked in a dispute over unpaid legal fees after Playboy accused the U.S. law firm of mishandling litigation and ignoring conflicts of interest while representing the adult entertainment company.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella
item.content:encoded: Playboy Enterprises and Quinn Emanuel are locked in a dispute over unpaid legal fees after Playboy accused the U.S. law firm of mishandling litigation and ignoring conflicts of interest while representing the adult entertainment company. Playboy sued the law firm in Los Angeles Superior Court last week, asking a judge to halt an arbitration proceeding in which Quinn Emanuel is seeking legal fees it claims it is owed by Playboy from litigation over its iconic "bunny" logo. The clash over fees stems from Quinn Emanuel's prior work for Playboy in a lawsuit that alleged sexual wellness company Advanced Vita Supplements infringed the company's bunny trademarks. Playboy claims Quinn Emanuel improperly steered the company away from naming additional defendants in the case because they were clients of the firm. Playboy argued in its August 18 filing that the arbitration should be paused until after a trial that is scheduled for March 2027 in the trademark case. The resolution of the trial, Playboy said, could affect its claims against the law firm. Quinn Emanuel "wants to force the issue of its fees before its own malpractice can be adjudicated — which is inherently unfair," Playboy said. The company said the law firm "routinely boasts on social media that it produced more than $2 billion in revenue last year; it does not urgently need another $700,000." Quinn Emanuel had no immediate comment on Monday. Playboy did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Quinn Emanuel is not a defendant in the underlying lawsuit. Quinn Emanuel in March initiated an arbitration proceeding seeking to recover about $712,000 in unpaid fees for its work on the Advanced Vita Supplements case. It represented Playboy in the case until 2024, when the company fired the firm and hired lawyers from law firm Frost. Playboy said it has already paid Quinn Emanuel more than $4.5 million and will show the firm "was massively overpaid for the work it actually performed." Quinn Emanuel has denied any wrongdoing, and argued that the fee arbitration is separate from Playboy's conflict-of-interest claims and should proceed. The firm in court filings has said its fees and costs billed to Playboy were reasonable. The case is Playboy Enterprises Inc v. item.title: Fire loan D Christopher Cupps to Scottish club
item.description: The Chicago Fire loaned homegrown defender Christopher Cupps to Scotland's Greenock Morton FC on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Chicago Fire loaned homegrown defender Christopher Cupps to Scotland's Greenock Morton FC on Monday. The loan runs through the end of 2026, with Chicago retaining the right to recall the teenager at any point. "We are excited to see Christopher continue to develop during the rest of the year in a new and challenging environment," Fire sporting director Gregg Broughton said. "He has a very high potential and promising future at the Chicago Fire and has stepped up to every challenge he has faced so far. Playing competitive matches during the rest of the year will only help him mature as a player and as a person." Cupps, 18, has appeared in six matches (three starts) for the Fire over the past two seasons. --Field Level Media

item.title: Senegal keeper Diaw joins Al Shabab
item.description: Senegal goalkeeper Mory Diaw has joined Al Shabab from Ligue 1 side Le Havre on a one-year deal, the Saudi Pro League club announced on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Senegal goalkeeper Mory Diaw has joined Al Shabab from Ligue 1 side Le Havre on a one-year deal, the Saudi Pro League club announced on Monday. The 33-year-old started this year's World Cup on the bench but came on as a substitute when Edouard Mendy was injured in Senegal's group match against Norway. He then played against Iraq and in the 3-2 defeat by Belgium in the round of 32. The PSG academy product made 30 appearances in Ligue 1 last season and has won eight caps. Al Shabab, who signed Ghana's [USN:L4N44I0TC TEXT:"Thomas Partey"] on a free transfer during the close season, have yet to register a win in the SPL after two games.

item.content:encoded: World's top oil exporter Saudi Aramco (2222.SE) has signed agreements with some French companies potentially worth over $3.7 billion in total, it said on Monday. The agreements include procurement deals for drilling equipment and oil country tubular goods, as well as a memorandum of understanding to explore industrial AI and related technologies. The company did not identify the French companies involved in the agreements.

item.title: Hyundai Motor's union reaches tentative wage deal with management, Yonhap reports
item.description: Hyundai Motor's South Korean union reached a tentative agreement with management on a 100,000 won ($72.31) monthly base salary increase, Yonhap News Agency reported on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Hyundai Motor's (005380.KS) South Korean union reached a tentative agreement with management on a 100,000 won ($72.31) monthly base salary increase, Yonhap News Agency reported on Tuesday. The deal comes after the union [USN:L1N44I02F TEXT:"staged its first full strike"] in a decade on Friday after wage talks stalled, as it sought a higher retirement age and job protections against artificial intelligence and automation. According to the Yonhap report, the tentative agreement includes a base salary increase plus a performance bonus and welfare points. From next year until 2028, 500 new technical workers will be hired, the report added. Hyundai Motor did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment outside regular business hours. Production at Hyundai's largest automobile factory in Ulsan city would have been suspended if the two sides had not reached a deal. The Ulsan plant has an annual capacity to produce about 1.5 million vehicles, accounting for roughly a quarter of Hyundai's total output. The union had demanded the company set aside 30% of net income for bonuses and guarantee job security, raising concerns over growing adoption of robotics and artificial intelligence on assembly lines. The world's third-largest automaker, which is also developing [USN:L1N43I027 TEXT:"humanoid robots"], appears to be planning to replace human workers with new technologies, a union leader said. "We already see lots of robots deployed in the factories," Kim Jin-wook, head of external relations for Hyundai's union, told Reuters. "We are demanding management increase new hires, as the company is trying to reduce headcounts." ($1 = 1,382.8900 won)

item.title: Aneel nega perícia pedida por Enel SP e fala em "desrespeito" da empresa à regulação
item.description: A diretoria da Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica (Aneel) negou nesta segunda-feira uma perícia pedida pela distribuidora Enel São Paulo no processo de caducidade da concessão, julgando a medida como desnecessária e classificando o posicionamento da empresa como "desrespeitoso" à regulação brasileira.
item.dc:creator: Leticia Augusto
item.content:encoded: A diretoria da Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica (Aneel) negou nesta segunda-feira uma perícia pedida pela distribuidora Enel São Paulo no processo de caducidade da concessão, julgando a medida como desnecessária e classificando o posicionamento da empresa como "desrespeitoso" à regulação brasileira. A italiana Enel (ENEI.MI) havia solicitado uma [USN:L1N41R0US TEXT:"perícia para sanar controvérsias"] com a área técnica da Aneel que apareceram no processo de caducidade, entendendo que a avaliação de um terceiro sobre dados metodológicos, estatísticos e outros seria "indispensável" para garantir a imparcialidade de uma decisão do órgão. Em seu voto, aprovado por unanimidade, a diretora relatora, Agnes da Costa, disse que a perícia só seria necessária caso houvesse algum fato relevante que não estivesse suficientemente esclarecido no processo, que pode culminar na perda do contrato pela Enel São Paulo. Costa afirmou ainda que a argumentação da Enel a favor da perícia traz "conclusões preocupantes", pois denota ou um "desconhecimento profundo" do funcionamento e competência legais da Aneel, ou desconsidera deliberadamente o modelo brasileiro de regulação do setor elétrico. "O posicionamento da concessionária não só é desrespeitoso como também se defronta com o arcabouço normativo do país", disse a diretora, acrescentando ainda que a postura adotada pela Enel sugere uma tentativa de retardar o fim do processo administrativo. O diretor-geral da Aneel, Sandoval Feitosa, também ressaltou a especialização técnica da agência reguladora e observou que, em uma eventual judicialização do caso, o juiz poderia solicitar a produção de prova pericial. "A Aneel, no ano em que faz 30 anos, ter suas competências legais sendo questionadas, e um pouco além, questionar a isenção e a imparcialidade do regulador brasileiro... é, no mínimo, inadequado", afirmou Feitosa. Procurada, a Enel afirmou que "não questiona a independência, a competência ou as atribuições legais da Aneel". Segundo a empresa, seu pedido de perícia visa "aprofundar a análise de aspectos técnicos complexos, como a excepcionalidade do evento climático de dezembro de 2025, seus efeitos sobre a infraestrutura elétrica e a aplicação de critérios ainda não regulamentados para eventos dessa natureza". O processo que trata da caducidade da concessão da Enel São Paulo entra agora na etapa final, após o regulador já ter [USN:L1N4480Y6 TEXT:"negado um recurso da empresa"]. A Enel tem dez dias para apresentar alegações finais, antes de o colegiado da Aneel decidir sobre a recomendação de caducidade ao Ministério de Minas e Energia. A Enel buscou anteriormente afastar a avaliação da Aneel de que a concessionária apresentou falhas estruturais na prestação dos serviços aos consumidores e no restabelecimento da energia após eventos climáticos que deixaram milhões sem luz.

item.title: Ex-Bengals TE CJ Uzomah retires after 10 seasons
item.description: Tight end C.J. Uzomah announced his retirement Monday after 10 NFL seasons.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tight end C.J. Uzomah announced his retirement Monday after 10 NFL seasons. He played his first seven seasons (2015-21) with the Cincinnati Bengals, who drafted him in the fifth round in 2015. Uzomah, 33, played two seasons with the New York Jets (2022-23) and appeared in seven regular-season games with the Super Bowl champion Philadelphia Eagles in 2024 before sitting out the 2025 campaign. "Retiring in Stripes," the Bengals posted on X, along with the words "Bengal Forever." Uzomah thanked the Bengals in a post on X. "History has a way of repeating itself and there's no place I'd want to formally announce my retirement, than the place that started it all for me and gave me my chance," he wrote. "The place I will always think of as my second home and will always hold a special place in me and my family's heart. The place where we won a playoff game for the first time since before I was born, and went on an odds defying run to the Super Bowl. A place I've met people who have become like brothers to me. Cincinnati, thank you for everything. Who Dey Forever." Uzomah caught 192 passes for 1,881 yards and 16 touchdowns in 113 career games (85 starts). --Field Level Media

item.title: Trump compró en junio acciones de SpaceX, la empresa de Elon Musk, según declaración patrimonial
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, invirtió en junio hasta 50.000 dólares en SpaceX, la empresa de Elon Musk, según una declaración financiera pública, lo que le otorga una participación financiera en una importante empresa contratista del Gobierno dirigida por su antiguo asesor.
item.dc:creator: Courtney Rozen
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, invirtió en junio hasta 50.000 dólares en SpaceX, la empresa de Elon Musk, según una declaración financiera pública, lo que le otorga una participación financiera en una importante empresa contratista del Gobierno dirigida por su antiguo asesor. Adquirió acciones por un valor de entre 15.001 y 50.000 dólares el 23 de junio, según una declaración financiera firmada por él el 12 de agosto y hecha pública el 22 de agosto. La compra formaba parte de las más de 1.000 operaciones bursátiles que el presidente realizó en junio. SpaceX salió a bolsa el 12 de junio, batiendo todos los récords de salidas a bolsa. En una declaración a Reuters, el portavoz de la Casa Blanca, Davis Ingle, afirmó que instituciones financieras independientes gestionan la cartera del presidente y replican "índices reconocidos, como el Schwab 1000". "Ni el presidente Trump ni ningún miembro de su familia tiene capacidad alguna para dirigir, influir o aportar ideas sobre cómo se invierte la cartera o cuándo se compran o venden las inversiones", afirmó Ingle en el comunicado. La inversión de Trump en SpaceX añade un nuevo vínculo financiero entre el presidente y la empresa de cohetes de Musk, en un momento en el que la Administración está tomando decisiones que podrían afectar al futuro de la empresa. SpaceX es un contratista del ejército estadounidense y a menudo solicita autorizaciones a agencias federales. El jueves, Trump ordenó a su equipo que ayudara a aumentar drásticamente el número de lanzamientos espaciales comerciales de Estados Unidos. SpaceX es una empresa dominante en ese sector. Reuters no pudo determinar de inmediato el importe exacto de la inversión, ya que los funcionarios federales utilizan rangos para declarar el valor de sus activos en sus declaraciones patrimoniales.

item.title: França e Arábia Saudita farão parque temático de Dragon Ball Z perto de Paris por 6 bilhões de euros
item.description: França e Arábia Saudita concordaram em construir um parque de diversões com temática de mangá no valor de 6 bilhões de euros (7 bilhões de dólares) perto de Paris, informou o Palácio do Eliseu nesta segunda-feira, durante uma visita do príncipe herdeiro saudita Mohammed bin Salman à capital francesa.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: França e Arábia Saudita concordaram em construir um parque de diversões com temática de mangá no valor de 6 bilhões de euros (7 bilhões de dólares) perto de Paris, informou o Palácio do Eliseu nesta segunda-feira, durante uma visita do príncipe herdeiro saudita Mohammed bin Salman à capital francesa. O projeto, inspirado no universo da famosa franquia japonesa de mangá e anime Dragon Ball Z, será construído perto de Cergy-Pontoise, a noroeste de Paris, e deve gerar cerca de 22 mil empregos, segundo o Palácio do Eliseu. A ideia surgiu depois que o presidente francês, Emmanuel Macron, e o príncipe herdeiro saudita descobriram que compartilhavam o mesmo entusiasmo por Dragon Ball Z durante a visita de Macron à Arábia Saudita em 2025, informaram assessores de Macron. O grupo saudita de entretenimento e investimentos Qiddiya financiará o projeto, que faz parte dos esforços do reino para diversificar sua economia para além do petróleo e expandir sua presença global no setor de lazer. Ainda não foi definida uma data de inauguração para o que seria um dos maiores parques temáticos da Europa, e a construção deve levar vários anos. Bin Salman, que possui um castelo perto de Paris, está realizando uma rara viagem oficial ao exterior e apareceu ao lado de Macron na cerimônia de encerramento da Copa do Mundo de Esports, em Paris, no domingo. Autoridades francesas apresentaram o projeto Dragon Ball Z como prova de que a França continua sendo um polo de atração para investimentos estrangeiros, embora detalhes-chave para o amplo empreendimento — que incluiria três parques temáticos diferentes — ainda estejam por definir.

item.title: Furacão Lala aciona pagamento de seguro de recifes de coral no Havaí
item.description: Uma apólice de seguro paramétrica elaborada pela Willis, que cobre os recifes de coral ao redor do Havaí, foi acionada pelo furacão Lala, informou a segurada, a The Nature Conservancy (TNC).
item.dc:creator: Henry Gale
item.content:encoded: Uma apólice de seguro paramétrica elaborada pela Willis, que cobre os recifes de coral ao redor do Havaí, foi acionada pelo furacão Lala, informou a segurada, a The Nature Conservancy (TNC). Trata-se do primeiro pagamento desde que a apólice foi contratada, informou a ONG ambiental em uma postagem de blog na quinta-feira. A TNC não divulgou o valor, mas afirmou que o pagamento mínimo é de US$200.000. A Willis anunciou o lançamento da apólice em 2022, descrevendo-a como a primeira apólice de seguro para recifes de coral nos EUA. O furacão Lala, a primeira tempestade nomeada da temporada de furacões do Pacífico Central, trouxe ventos fortes e inundações para a ilha do Havaí ao passar ao sul do território no início deste mês. O desembolso do valor do seguro será determinado em colaboração com a Rede de Restauração de Emergência dos Recifes do Havaí (Herr, na sigla em inglês), um grupo composto por órgãos governamentais, cientistas, organizações sem fins lucrativos e grupos comunitários, informou a TNC. Os recursos serão utilizados para avaliar os recifes e determinar as próximas etapas para resgatar, recolocar e reparar quaisquer corais danificados, acrescentou a organização. Julia Rose, gerente do programa de restauração de corais da TNC no Havaí e em Palmyra, afirmou que os "recifes enfrentam muitas ameaças que estão além da nossa capacidade de lidar localmente, mas os danos físicos causados por tempestades são um impacto sobre o qual podemos agir". "Ao agirmos rapidamente para avaliar e reparar os recifes danificados, podemos dar aos corais uma chance maior de se recuperarem e continuarem a sustentar as comunidades do Havaí." Tanto a TNC quanto a Fundação Howden forneceram apoio que possibilitou a contratação da apólice, informou a TNC. Jody Yee, chefe de soluções alternativas de transferência de risco no âmbito das Américas na Willis, disse que o pagamento demonstra o valor de soluções inovadoras de risco. “Ao fornecer financiamento rápido imediatamente após um evento desencadeador, o programa ajuda a proteger ecossistemas críticos de recifes de corais e apoia uma recuperação mais rápida para as comunidades que dependem deles”, disse ele. “Este é o seguro paramétrico funcionando exatamente como pretendido: financiamento rápido e transparente quando é mais necessário, possibilitando a ação, em vez da espera. É um exemplo poderoso de como a transferência de risco pode apoiar tanto a resiliência ambiental quanto a sustentabilidade de longo prazo.”

item.title: Dangote refinery drives seven-fold rise in Nigeria petroleum product exports, EIA says
item.description: Seaborne petroleum product exports from Nigeria have grown seven-fold since 2023, as output from the Dangote refinery improved regional fuel trade flows and boosted supplies to Europe and Africa, the U.S. Energy Information Administration said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Seaborne petroleum product exports from Nigeria have grown seven-fold since 2023, as output from the Dangote refinery improved regional fuel trade flows and boosted supplies to Europe and Africa, the U.S. Energy Information Administration said on Monday. Here are more details: Seaborne petroleum product shipments from Nigeria averaged 561,000 barrels per day in the second quarter of 2026, compared with an annual average of 79,000 bpd in 2023, Vortexa data showed. Of those shipments 350,000 bpd were exported during that period, compared with an annual average of 46,000 bpd in 2023. Dangote Group's Dangote Petroleum Refinery, located in the Lekki Free Zone near Lagos, began operations in 2024 and is the country's largest refinery. With the increased supply of petroleum products in Nigeria from the country's largest refinery, imports fell, exports increased, and Nigeria became more self-sufficient in refined petroleum products, EIA said. Product shipments expanded after operations at Dangote began and again following the completion of maintenance and expansion in February 2026, coinciding with supply constraints out of the Strait of Hormuz, EIA added. The maintenance increased the facility's crude oil distillation capacity from 650,000 bpd to 700,000 bpd. Intra-Nigerian shipments rose to 211,000 bpd in the second quarter of 2026, up from 81,000 bpd in 2025 and 33,000 bpd in 2023. Nigeria's seaborne petroleum product exports to Europe rose to 130,000 bpd in the second quarter of 2026 from 40,000 bpd in 2025 and 15,000 bpd in 2023, while exports to Africa climbed to nearly 120,000 bpd from 89,000 bpd a year earlier. Nigeria imported nearly 400,000 bpd of petroleum products in 2023, and seaborne imports fell to less than 130,000 bpd in the second quarter of 2026.

item.title: US removes Syria's designation as State Sponsor of Terrorism list

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The State Department on Monday removed Syria from its list of State Sponsors of Terrorism, according to a notification from the U.S. Treasury, in a move that was first announced earlier this year pending a review by Congress. The designation as a state sponsor of terrorism carries restrictions on U.S. foreign assistance, defense exports and certain financial transactions. Monday's announcement also removed the designation of the Nusrah Front as a Specially Designated Global Terrorist organization.

item.title: Francia y Arabia Saudita acuerdan proyecto de parque temático de "Dragon Ball Z" cerca de París
item.description: Francia y Arabia Saudita acordaron construir un parque de atracciones inspirado en el manga "Dragon Ball Z", con un costo de 6.000 millones de euros (7.000 millones de dólares), cerca de París, informó el Palacio del Elíseo el lunes durante la visita del príncipe heredero saudita Mohammed bin Salman a la capital francesa.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Francia y Arabia Saudita acordaron construir un parque de atracciones inspirado en el manga "Dragon Ball Z", con un costo de 6.000 millones de euros (7.000 millones de dólares), cerca de París, informó el Palacio del Elíseo el lunes durante la visita del príncipe heredero saudita Mohammed bin Salman a la capital francesa. El proyecto, inspirado en el mundo de la exitosa franquicia japonesa de manga y anime, se construirá cerca de Cergy-Pontoise, al noroeste de la capital francesa, y se espera que genere unos 22.000 puestos de trabajo, según el Elíseo. La idea surgió después de que el presidente francés, Emmanuel Macron, y el príncipe heredero saudí descubrieran que compartían la misma pasión por Dragon Ball Z durante la visita de Macron a Arabia Saudita en 2025, según explicaron los asesores del mandatario francés. El grupo saudita de entretenimiento e inversión Qiddiya financiará el proyecto, que forma parte de la apuesta del reino por diversificar su economía más allá del petróleo y ampliar su presencia global en el sector del ocio. Aún no se ha fijado una fecha de inauguración para lo que sería uno de los complejos de parques temáticos más grandes de Europa, y se prevé que la construcción dure varios años. Bin Salman, propietario de un castillo cerca de París, está realizando un inusual viaje oficial al extranjero y apareció junto a Macron en la ceremonia de clausura de la Copa del Mundo de Esports celebrada el domingo en París. Las autoridades francesas presentan el proyecto de Dragon Ball Z como prueba de que Francia sigue siendo un imán para la inversión extranjera, aunque aún quedan por concretar detalles clave de este ambicioso complejo, que incluiría tres parques temáticos diferentes. item.title: Plaintiffs lawyers' fee slashed in Google privacy settlement
item.description: A U.S. federal judge in San Jose has awarded Bartlit Beck and other plaintiffs’ firms a reduced legal fee of about $29 million for their work on a settlement resolving a lawsuit that accused Google of programming its Android operating system to collect the cellular data of smartphone users without their permission.
item.dc:creator: David Thomas, Mike Scarcella
item.content:encoded:
A U.S. federal judge in San Jose has awarded Bartlit Beck and other plaintiffs’ firms a reduced legal fee of about $29 million for their work on a [USN:L6N3YT0WU TEXT:"settlement"] resolving a lawsuit that accused Google of programming its Android operating system to collect the cellular data of smartphone users without their permission. Here are the details: U.S. Magistrate Judge Virginia DeMarchi approved the settlement on Friday but said the requested fee of nearly $40 million would have overcompensated the plaintiffs' lawyers. The judge said the settlement's primary value was not money for class members but a requirement that Google provide disclosures about Android users' cellular data. Google in January agreed to pay $135 million to settle the proposed class action. As part of the settlement, the Alphabet unit (GOOGL.O) said it will not transfer data without obtaining consent from Android users when they set up their phones. “While the value of such transparency cannot be easily or accurately quantified, such relief is still significant in that it enables users to make informed decisions about whether to consent to the cellular data usage and continue using Android devices,” DeMarchi wrote in her order. The initial $39.8 million sought by lead plaintiffs' attorneys at Bartlit Beck and Korein Tillery amounted to about 29% of the settlement fund. Attorneys at those firms did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Google had opposed the requested legal fees. A spokesperson for the company did not immediately respond to a request for comment. DeMarch

i also granted final approval to the settlement on Friday.
