item.title: Trump bought shares in Elon Musk's SpaceX in June, financial disclosure shows
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump invested as much as $50,000 in Elon Musk's SpaceX in June, according to a public financial disclosure, giving him a financial stake in a major government contractor run by his former adviser.
item.dc:creator: Courtney Rozen
item.content:encoded: U.S. President Donald Trump invested as much as $50,000 in Elon Musk's SpaceX in June, according to a public financial disclosure, giving him a financial stake in a major government contractor run by his former adviser. He bought between $15,001 and $50,000 in shares on June 23, according to a financial disclosure signed by him on August 12 and made public on August 22. The purchase was part of more than 1,000 stock trades the president made in June. SpaceX held its initial public offering on June 12, which demolished IPO records. In a statement to Reuters, White House spokesman Davis Ingle said that third-party financial institutions independently manage the president's portfolio and replicate "recognized indexes, such as the Schwab 1000." "Neither President Trump nor any member of his family has any ability to direct, influence, or provide input regarding how the portfolio is invested or when investments are bought or sold," Ingle said in the statement. Trump's investment in SpaceX adds a new financial link between the president and Musk's rocket company at a time when the administration is making decisions that could affect the firm's fortunes. SpaceX is a U.S. military [USN:L1N3P10ZT TEXT:"contractor,"] and often seeks [USN:L1N43U12L TEXT:"approvals"] from federal agencies. Trump on Thursday [USN:S0N3ZQ02C TEXT:"directed"] his team to help drastically increase the number of U.S. commercial space launches. SpaceX is a dominant player in that sector. Reuters could not immediately determine the precise amount of the investment because federal officials use ranges to declare the value of their assets on their financial disclosure forms.

item.title: Two U.N. peacekeepers from Ethiopia killed in South Sudan ambush
item.description: Two U.N. peacekeepers from Ethiopia were killed and seven other people injured in an ambush on Monday in South Sudan's Jonglei State, bringing to nine the number of peacekeepers killed in the line of duty worldwide this year, the United Nations said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Two U.N. peacekeepers from Ethiopia were killed and seven other people injured in an ambush on Monday in South Sudan's Jonglei State, bringing to nine the number of peacekeepers killed in the line of duty worldwide this year, the United Nations said. Among the injured were three U.N. peacekeepers, two police officers from South Sudan and two civilian staff members, U.N. spokesperson Stephane Dujarric told a press briefing. He said the attack was carried out by unidentified gunmen and the patrol appeared to have been deliberately targeted. "These are part of regular patrols that the U.N. has been doing in trying to help the constant insecurity in the area," Dujarric said. The U.N. has called on relevant authorities for a thorough and prompt investigation to ensure all those responsible are brought to justice, Dujarric said. He stressed that "attacks against U.N. peacekeepers may constitute war crimes under international law." The latest violence "brings to nine the number of peacekeepers killed in malicious acts since January 1 of this year," he added. Attacks on U.N. personnel are rare but not unprecedented in South Sudan, where U.N. patrols operate in volatile areas affected by intercommunal fighting, armed youth mobilizations and clashes involving government forces. In June, the U.N. Security Council adopted a resolution aimed at [USN:L1N42U11Y TEXT:"strengthening accountability for attacks on U.N. peacekeepers"], amid concern over rising violence and low prosecution rates. That followed a series of incidents targeting U.N. personnel, including the [USN:L1N42C0PN TEXT:"killing of seven peacekeepers serving with the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon"] after a fresh round of fighting broke out between Israel and Hezbollah in early March.

item.title: Alibaba lança modelo de vídeo com IA Wan3.0 após venda de ações de US$10 bilhões
item.description: A Alibaba lançou oficialmente nesta segunda-feira seu mais recente modelo de geração de vídeo com inteligência artificial, o Wan3.0, com recursos aprimorados, após a gigante chinesa da internet ter lançado uma emissão de ações no valor de US$10 bilhões para financiar os crescentes gastos com IA.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Alibaba (9988.HK) lançou oficialmente nesta segunda-feira seu mais recente modelo de geração de vídeo com inteligência artificial, o Wan3.0, com recursos aprimorados, após a gigante chinesa da internet ter lançado uma emissão de ações no valor de US$10 bilhões para financiar os crescentes gastos com IA. O novo modelo é capaz de gerar vídeos de 30 segundos a partir de documentos, planilhas, apresentações e páginas da web, informou a Alibaba Cloud em uma publicação na plataforma WeChat. A Alibaba informou que o Wan3.0 vem sendo utilizado na produção de curtas-metragens e filmes, em publicidade e marketing, na promoção turística e na criação de videoclipes desde que uma versão beta pública foi lançada em 6 de agosto. O lançamento ocorre um dia após o Alibaba ter anunciado a venda de ações, a maior oferta primária subsequente já realizada por uma empresa listada em Hong Kong, à medida que aumenta seus gastos na cada vez mais acirrada corrida global pela IA. Na semana passada, a Alibaba divulgou uma queda de 75% nos lucros trimestrais em relação ao ano anterior, devido ao aumento vertiginoso dos gastos de capital relacionados à IA. (Reportagem de Ethan Wang e Eduardo Baptista)

item.title: Italy regulator clears Ludoil's acquisition of Sicilian oil refiner
item.description: Italy's competition authority has cleared the acquisition of Sicily-based oil refiner ISAB by energy group Ludoil, the watchdog said on Monday, opening the way for a local company to control one fifth of the country's refining capacity.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Italy's competition authority has cleared the [USN:L8N41Q1HU TEXT:"acquisition"] of Sicily-based oil refiner ISAB by energy group Ludoil, the watchdog said on Monday, opening the way for a local company to control one fifth of the country's refining capacity. Ludoil agreed in May to buy 51% of ISAB from Cypriot private equity fund G.O.I. Energy, subject to several conditions. The antitrust regulator said that the transaction would not hamper competition in the Italian market for refined products in a significant way, adding it would not open a full investigation on the acquisition. The refiner is linked to an exclusive long-term contract with global commodity trader Trafigura until 2033, the watchdog said in its document, revealing interesting details regarding its business. The supply and offtake agreement commits ISAB to sell approximately 90% of its refined petroleum products to Trafigura while Trafigura supplies ISAB with crude oil and the other raw materials required for refining, the competition authority said.

item.title: Israeli fire kills two young children in Gaza, medics say
item.description: Israeli airstrikes and gunfire killed two young children and at least two other Palestinians in the Gaza Strip on Monday, health officials in the territory said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Israeli airstrikes and gunfire killed two young children and at least two other Palestinians in the Gaza Strip on Monday, health officials in the territory said. Medics and relatives said 10-year-old Amal Abu Khater was hit by a bullet in her back while she was eating inside her family's tent in the enclave's southern city of Khan Younis. The fire came from Israeli forces to the east, they added. The Israeli military said it was not aware of any incident involving a 10-year-old girl. A four-year-old boy and another Palestinian were killed in separate Israeli airstrikes on a house in Bureij refugee camp and a road in Khan Younis, medics said. Earlier on Monday, another Israeli airstrike killed one person and wounded another at a tent in Deir Al-Balah in the central Gaza Strip, medics said. The Israeli military said that strike in Deir Al-Balah targeted a Hamas militant, but did not specifically respond to questions about the other two reported attacks in Khan Younis and Bureij. More than 1,280 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza since a ceasefire took effect last October , according to Gazan health officials, while the Israeli military says four Israeli soldiers have been killed. Hamas accuses Israel of violating the ceasefire and undermining efforts to implement a broader plan by U.S. President Donald Trump to end the Gaza conflict, which also includes Israeli withdrawals and Hamas disarmament. Israel says its strikes aimed to thwart imminent attacks by Hamas and other Gaza militants. The Israeli military issued two separate evacuation orders in Beach refugee camp and Deir Al-Balah in northern and central Gaza Strip before it carried out airstrikes in the two areas, without reports of casualties, residents and medics said. It also bombed a desalination plant in the Sheikh Radwan neighbourhood in Gaza City, at a time when the enclave is suffering water shortages, residents and Hamas said. An Israeli military spokesperson said the military had carried out strikes on several Hamas weapons storage sites throughout the day, including two inside mosques. The spokesperson said that among the sites targeted on Monday was one located adjacent to a desalination facility. The spokesperson said the military had not targeted the desalination facility and did not say whether or not it had been damaged in the strike.

item.title: Xiaomi lança novo chip Xring e faz parceria com TSMC para produção
item.description: A fabricante chinesa de smartphones Xiaomi divulgou nesta segunda-feira uma nova versão de seu microprocessador desenvolvido internamente, o Xring, apostando que um controle mais profundo sobre os principais componentes ajudará a fortalecer sua cadeia de suprimentos e a reduzir a dependência de fornecedores externos de chips.
item.dc:creator: Che Pan, Eduardo Baptista
item.content:encoded: A fabricante chinesa de smartphones Xiaomi (1810.HK) divulgou nesta segunda-feira uma nova versão de seu microprocessador desenvolvido internamente, o Xring, apostando que um controle mais profundo sobre os principais componentes ajudará a fortalecer sua cadeia de suprimentos e a reduzir a dependência de fornecedores externos de chips. O lançamento do Xring O3 ocorre um ano após a Xiaomi ter lançado seu primeiro processador próprio para smartphones, o Xring O1, marcando o mais recente passo da terceira maior fabricante mundial de smartphones em sua iniciativa de se juntar a rivais como Apple (AAPL.O) , Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) e Huawei no desenvolvimento de seus próprios chips. A TSMC (2330.TW) fabricará o novo chip da Xiaomi utilizando tecnologia de produção de 3 nanômetros, segundo duas fontes a par do assunto. Uma das fontes disse que o chip deve equipar o próximo smartphone dobrável da Xiaomi, com uma meta de entregas de 200 mil a 300 mil unidades. Representantes da Xiaomi e da TSMC não comentaram o assunto. Os processadores de smartphones, ou sistemas em chip (SoC), integram funções de computação, gráficos, processamento de IA e imagem em um único componente. A aposta da Xiaomi em chips reflete uma tendência mais ampla do setor, à medida que os fabricantes de dispositivos buscam diferenciar seus produtos e diminuir a dependência de fornecedores como Qualcomm (QCOM.O) e MediaTek (2454.TW) em meio à intensificação da concorrência no segmento de smartphones premium. A Xiaomi afirmou na semana passada que as vendas acumuladas de dispositivos equipados com o Xring O1 — incluindo smartphones, tablets e relógios — ultrapassaram 1 milhão de unidades desde seu lançamento. A Xiaomi vendeu cerca de 150 mil smartphones equipados com Xring O1 desde o lançamento, em maio de 2025, segundo as fontes.

item.title: France, Saudi Arabia agree on €6 billion Dragon Ball Z theme park project near Paris
item.description: France and Saudi Arabia have agreed to build a €6 billion ($7 billion) manga-themed amusement park near Paris, the Elysee Palace said on Monday during a visit by Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman to the French capital.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: France and Saudi Arabia have agreed to build a €6 billion ($7 billion) manga-themed amusement park near Paris, the Elysee Palace said on Monday during a visit by Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman to the French capital. The project, inspired by the world of the hit Japanese manga and anime franchise Dragon Ball Z, will be built near Cergy-Pontoise, northwest of Paris, and is expected to create around 22,000 jobs, the Elysee said. The idea was born after French President Emmanuel Macron and the Saudi crown prince discovered a shared enthusiasm for Dragon Ball Z during Macron’s visit to Saudi Arabia in 2025, Macron advisers said. Saudi entertainment and investment group Qiddiya will finance the project, which forms part of the kingdom’s push to [USN:L6N42B0X9 TEXT:"diversify its economy"] beyond oil and expand its global footprint in the leisure industry. No opening date has been set for what would be one of Europe’s largest theme park developments, with construction expected to take several years. Bin Salman, who owns a chateau near Paris, is making a rare official trip abroad and appeared alongside Macron at the closing ceremony of the Esports World Cup in Paris on Sunday. French officials cast the Dragon Ball Z project as evidence that France remains a magnet for foreign investment, though key details for the sprawling development that would include three different theme parks are yet to be settled. ($1 = 0.8571 euros)

item.title: UK, Ukraine sign AI defence partnership linked to battlefield technology
item.description: Britain said on Monday it had signed a partnership with Ukraine to jointly develop artificial intelligence tools for defence and security, giving British researchers access to a Ukrainian battlefield data platform used to train military AI systems.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain said on Monday it had signed a partnership with Ukraine to jointly develop artificial intelligence tools for defence and security, giving British researchers access to a Ukrainian battlefield data platform used to train military AI systems. Prime Minister Andy Burnham and President Volodymyr Zelenskiy signed the agreement in Kyiv, making Britain the first international partner to access Ukraine's Avengers AI Labs, a government statement said. Avengers Labs was built around an annotated dataset of 5 million battlefield images, Ukraine's Defence Ministry said earlier in August, largely drawn from the military's DELTA combat system – a domestically developed battlefield management and situational-awareness system. The platform uses data collected from cameras and sensors across Ukraine's battlefield, including information on tanks, artillery systems, drones and other military targets. The Ukrainian ministry said AI models trained on the data were already being used in an automated target-detection system that analyses more than 100,000 drone video feeds each month and can identify about 70% of enemy targets in real time. Under the deal, Britain and Ukraine will collaborate on pilot projects including technology that uses fibre-optic cables as AI-enabled sensors to help protect military facilities, and research into low-power AI chips for drones and autonomous systems. The British government said the partnership would initially focus on defence and national security projects bringing together researchers, engineers, technology companies and military experts from both countries. Burnham on Monday visited Ukraine for his first trip abroad since becoming prime minister, where he had talks with Zelenskiy and co-chaired a meeting of the "Coalition of the Willing." His office had earlier announced Britain would allow missile maker MBDA to [USN:L4N44K01O TEXT:"release classified information"] on British-made components used in the SCALP long-range cruise missile to help establish assembly lines in Ukraine.

item.title: Bancos defendem que Brasil faça lição de casa para enfrentar mundo mais complexo
item.description: A poucos meses das eleições no Brasil, presidentes de vários dos principais bancos do país defenderam nesta segunda-feira o equilíbrio das contas públicas e uma agenda para melhorar a produtividade, ressaltando um ambiente externo mais complexo.
item.dc:creator: Paula Arend Laier
item.content:encoded: A poucos meses das eleições no Brasil, presidentes de vários dos principais bancos do país defenderam nesta segunda-feira o equilíbrio das contas públicas e uma agenda para melhorar a produtividade, ressaltando um ambiente externo mais complexo. "O que nós queremos ver efetivamente é equilíbrio fiscal, é um equilíbrio dessa dívida para que ela não suba nessa proporção em relação ao PIB", ressaltou o presidente-executivo do Bradesco , Marcelo Noronha, em painel durante evento de tecnologia no setor financeiro organizado pela federação de bancos, Febraban, em São Paulo. "É preciso haver vontade política para fazer isso", acrescentou o executivo. A dívida pública bruta do país como proporção do PIB fechou junho em 81,9%, contra 81,0% no mês anterior. Já a dívida líquida do setor público foi a 68,5%, de 67,9%. O Tesouro Nacional projeta que o indicador seguirá em alta até 2029. Desde que o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva assumiu o cargo, em janeiro de 2023, a dívida bruta do Brasil, considerada o principal indicador da solvência do país, [USN:L1N43X0M1 TEXT:"aumentou"] 10,2 pontos percentuais do PIB. O presidente-executivo do Itaú Unibanco , Milton Maluhy Filho, afirmou que é preciso olhar a questão do endividamento público. "A trajetória da dívida nesse ritmo é insustentável", afirmou, reforçando que o país deve parar de falar de superávit primário e déficit primário e falar de déficit nominal. "Com uma dívida de R$10 trilhões com juros a 14%, essa conta no longo prazo é muito complexa, não tem nenhuma economia que resista a um juro real no nível que estamos vivendo", afirmou. Maluhy Filho lembrou que os juros no nível atual prejudicam o principal negócio dos bancos, a concessão de crédito, uma vez que em cenários restritivos com o atual a inadimplência cresce e o setor é forçado a emprestar menos. O déficit nominal do Brasil subiu para quase 10% do Produto Interno Bruto (PIB) nos 12 meses até junho, de acordo com dados divulgados no final de julho pelo Banco Central, atingindo o nível mais alto desde 2021 sob o impacto da conta de juros. O rombo aumentou para R$1,318 trilhão, o equivalente a 9,99% do PIB, ante 9,61% até maio e 7,27% um ano antes. Na próxima semana, uma atualização dos números vai ser divulgada pelo Banco Central. O presidente-executivo do Santander Brasil , Gilson Finkelsztain, reforçou o discurso afirmando que o Brasil precisa se ajustar rápido porque o cenário global vai ser mais difícil, em meio a uma "competição por capital" em que outras economias também estão elevando os juros. "Toda esta agenda local precisa ter o dobro de esforço para botar ordem na casa porque o mundo está mais complexo", afirmou. O presidente-executivo do BTG Pactual , Roberto Sallouti, chamou atenção para questões como custo de capital, governança fiscal e produtividade. "Nós não podemos contar com o crescimento populacional para aumentar o nosso próprio potencial. Nós temos que ganhar produtividade. Educação, uso de tecnologia, infraestrutura e assim por diante", afirmou, destacando a inteligência artificial. "Nós estamos vivendo uma revolução tecnológica, que primeiro está levando um capex (investimento) enorme que está pressionando os mercados, e depois vai gerar ganhos de produtividade inimagináveis", disse Sallouti.

item.title: GRANOS Maíz alcanza máximo en tres años en Chicago, operadores prevén una menor producción en EEUU
item.description: Los futuros del maíz de Chicago se dispararon el lunes hasta alcanzar máximos de tres años, después de que una visita a la zona productora de maíz y soja de Estados Unidos la semana pasada revelara que la cosecha del cereal se encontraba en peores condiciones de lo que muchos esperaban.
item.dc:creator: Heather Schlitz
item.content:encoded: Los futuros del maíz de Chicago se dispararon el lunes hasta alcanzar máximos de tres años, después de que una visita a la zona productora de maíz y soja de Estados Unidos la semana pasada revelara que la cosecha del cereal se encontraba en peores condiciones de lo que muchos esperaban. El trigo alcanzó su nivel más alto en unos dos años, ya que los ataques recíprocos entre Rusia y Ucrania limitaron las exportaciones desde los puertos del Mar Negro. La soja bajó, presionada por la caída del precio del petróleo, pero las pérdidas se vieron limitadas por la fuerte demanda de exportación de soja estadounidense. El contrato de maíz más activo de la Bolsa de Chicago sumaba 10,25 centavos a 5,1875 dólares por bushel a las 1530 GMT, tras alcanzar los 5,2525 dólares por bushel, su nivel más alto desde 2023. La mayoría de los contratos de maíz registraron máximos históricos. "El mercado repuntó durante la noche tras los datos del viernes publicados al cierre de la sesión", afirmó Joe Davis, director de ventas de materias primas de Futures International. El servicio de asesoramiento Pro Farmer estimó el viernes que la producción de maíz de Estados Unidos en 2026 se situará muy por debajo de las previsiones del Gobierno, después de que una gira por siete de los principales estados productores revelara que las cosechas, por debajo de lo habitual, se han visto perjudicadas por las condiciones meteorológicas adversas del verano. Pro Farmer prevé que los agricultores cosechen 15.344 millones de bushels de maíz, un 9,9% menos que en 2025, pero aún así la tercera cosecha más grande de la historia, con un rendimiento medio de 173,2 bushels por acre. La estimación de rendimiento de Pro Farmer para Estados Unidos, de concretarse, sería la más baja desde 2020. "La gente se quedó sorprendida al ver esa cifra", dijo Davis. Los operadores también temen que el fenómeno meteorológico de El Niño reduzca la producción de maíz en Brasil y están preocupados por la capacidad de Ucrania para exportar, según los analistas. En cuanto a otros cultivos, el trigo de la CBOT subió 4 centavos a 7,03 dólares el bushel tras alcanzar su máximo en aproximadamente dos años. La soja cayó 18 centavos a 12,2150 dólares el bushel. El trigo se vio sometido a presión el lunes después de que el presidente de Ucrania, Volodímir Zelenski, afirmara que se seguiría una "vía diplomática" con Rusia para debatir la intensificación de los ataques de Moscú en el mar Negro. Las exportaciones de trigo del mar Negro se han visto gravemente reducidas debido a la escalada de ataques en la región. "Hoy no hay un bloqueo total, pero se está intentando establecerlo. No obstante, entre tres y cuatro barcos al día entran y salen del área metropolitana de Odesa", afirmó Zelenski. La debilidad de los precios del aceite de soja lastró al complejo de la soja el lunes. El aceite de soja cayó debido al efecto de contagio de la debilidad del petróleo, que bajó más de 1 dólar por barril, ya que los inversionistas recogieron beneficios tras las recientes alzas.

item.title: Report: Patriots sign P Matt Haack
item.description: The Patriots signed veteran punter Matt Haack on Monday, according to ESPN.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Patriots signed veteran punter Matt Haack on Monday, according to ESPN. New England coach Mike Vrabel told reporters that the team would be adding a new punter after Bryce Baringer was forced to exit Saturday's preseason win over the Philadelphia Eagles with an injury. Haack, 32, was most recently with the Washington Commanders this offseason as a temporary injury replacement for Tress Way before he was released last week. He saw action last season, his ninth in the NFL, for the Arizona Cardinals, punting 25 times over seven games and averaging 51.3 yards per punt and 43.4 net yards per punt. Haack appeared in 12 games over the last three seasons after serving as a full-time starter for his first six NFL seasons. He has career averages of 45.0 yards per punt and 39.9 net yards per punt over 478 punts across 110 games for the Miami Dolphins (2017-20), Buffalo Bills (2021), Indianapolis Colts (2022), Cleveland Browns (2023), New York Giants (2024) and Cardinals. --Field Level Media

item.title: Ações ficam estáveis enquanto mercados avaliam tensões no Irã e aguardam dados econômicos
item.description: As ações europeias permaneceram estáveis nesta segunda-feira, enquanto os mercados acompanhavam os desdobramentos entre os Estados Unidos e o Irã e se preparavam para uma semana repleta de dados econômicos que podem oferecer novas pistas sobre a trajetória da política monetária do Banco Central Europeu.
item.dc:creator: Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Utkarsh Hathi
item.content:encoded: As ações europeias permaneceram estáveis nesta segunda-feira, enquanto os mercados acompanhavam os desdobramentos entre os Estados Unidos e o Irã e se preparavam para uma semana repleta de dados econômicos que podem oferecer novas pistas sobre a trajetória da política monetária do Banco Central Europeu. Os investidores se preparavam para os detalhes de possíveis sanções secundárias mais duras dos EUA contra países com laços comerciais com o Irã, que devem ser anunciadas pelo secretário do Tesouro, Scott Bessent. Separadamente, o chefe do Exército do Paquistão está em Teerã para levar o Irã de volta à mesa de negociações. “Há muitas incógnitas em torno disso (das sanções) no momento”, disse Chris Beauchamp, analista-chefe de mercado do IG Group. “Se houver uma situação em que a ação dos EUA seja interpretada como uma ameaça à economia iraniana e eles respondam da única maneira que podem, tomando medidas no Estreito de Ormuz, isso seria particularmente ruim para os mercados europeus.” O índice pan-europeu STOXX 600 (.STOXX) fechou inalterado em 654,21 pontos. Entre os setores, as ações de viagens e lazer lideraram os ganhos, subindo 1,7%, enquanto o petróleo Brent recuou 1,9%. As ações do setor de mídia (.SXPP) e de bens pessoais e domésticos (.SXQP) tiveram alta de 1,4%. O índice de referência STOXX 600 recuou nas últimas semanas após atingir máximas históricas neste mês impulsionado por uma alta nos lucros, com as preocupações com a inflação ganhando destaque. Os mercados monetários estão precificando uma ação mais hawkish por parte do Banco Central Europeu, apostando que as tensões geopolíticas possam manter as pressões sobre os preços elevadas e levar a taxa de depósito para perto de 3% até o final de 2027. Os investidores também aguardam uma série de divulgações econômicas nesta semana, incluindo dados do PIB alemão e francês, a pesquisa Ifo alemã e os números da inflação espanhola, que podem testar as expectativas de uma postura mais hawkish do BCE em meio à pressão renovada dos preços da energia. Em LONDRES, o índice Financial Times (.FTSE) avançou 0,35%, a 10.854,32 pontos. Em FRANKFURT, o índice DAX (.GDAXI) caiu 0,11%, a 26.106,60 pontos. Em PARIS, o índice CAC-40 (.FCHI) perdeu 0,37%, a 8.453,01 pontos. Em MILÃO, o índice Ftse/Mib (.FTMIB) teve desvalorização de 0,24%, a 52.542,18 pontos. Em MADRI, o índice Ibex-35 (.IBEX) registrou alta de 0,69%, a 20.098,60 pontos. Em LISBOA, o índice PSI20 (.PSI20) valorizou-se 0,40%, a 9.391,96 pontos.

item.title: Brasileña Braskem aprueba una reestructuración extrajudicial por 10.900 millones de dólares
item.description: El directorio de la empresa petroquímica brasileña Braskem aprobó solicitar una reestructuración extrajudicial para renegociar unos 10.900 millones de dólares de deuda no garantizada, indicó el lunes en un comunicado al regulador de valores.
item.dc:creator: Luciana Magalhaes
item.content:encoded: El directorio de la empresa petroquímica brasileña Braskem aprobó solicitar una reestructuración extrajudicial para renegociar unos 10.900 millones de dólares de deuda no garantizada, indicó el lunes en un comunicado al regulador de valores. Braskem (BRKM3.SA) , la mayor compañía petroquímica de Latinoamérica, se ha visto afectada por una prolongada recesión en el sector y por una catástrofe relacionada con sus minas de sal en el noreste de Brasil, lo que ha debilitado gravemente su situación de efectivo. La empresa solicitará la reestructuración extrajudicial una vez que se haya ultimado la documentación pertinente, añadió. Las acciones de Braskem caían hasta un 4,5 por ciento tras el anuncio, lo que las convirtió en las que peor se comportaron en el índice bursátil de referencia de Brasil, el Bovespa (.BVSP) , que subía un 1 por ciento. Sin embargo, esta medida no ha sido una sorpresa, dados los problemas de deuda que Braskem arrastra desde hace tiempo, y tras las recientes rebajas de las calificaciones crediticias de la empresa por parte de Fitch y Moody’s. Reuters informó este mes de que el gigante petroquímico se encontraba en negociaciones avanzadas para solicitar una reestructuración extrajudicial en Brasil antes de finales de agosto, ya que estaba a punto de expirar una protección de emergencia de 60 días. "Creemos que la noticia ya se esperaba, dado el fin de la medida cautelar que concedía la protección de 60 días", señalaron los analistas de Citi en una nota a sus clientes. Braskem Idesa, una compañía conjunta entre la firma brasileña y el Grupo Idesa de México, solicitó la semana pasada acogerse al Capítulo 11 de la Ley de Quiebras de Estados Unidos. La propuesta de reestructuración extrajudicial se elaborará en un plazo de 90 días, informaron a Reuters tres fuentes familiarizadas con el asunto bajo condición de anonimato. El plan podría incluir una oferta pública de venta de acciones posterior, lo que podría allanar el camino para una ampliación de capital en la que participen inversionistas externos, añadieron las fuentes. El control de Braskem lo comparten la firma de capital riesgo IG4 Capital, que recientemente adquirió una participación del grupo de ingeniería Novonor, y la petrolera estatal Petrobras (PETR3.SA) . Los analistas de UBS BB señalaron que una resolución definitiva del proceso de reestructuración de la empresa podría llevar tiempo, pero la ausencia de una inyección de capital inmediata reduce, por el momento, el riesgo de dilución para los accionistas. Braskem señaló que el procedimiento extrajudicial se limitaba a la reestructuración de sus pasivos financieros y no afectaría a las obligaciones con proveedores, clientes u otras partes interesadas.

item.title: Steelers activate CB Jalen Ramsey (knee) from PUP list
item.description: The Pittsburgh Steelers activated eight-time Pro Bowl cornerback Jalen Ramsey from the physically unable to perform list on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Pittsburgh Steelers activated eight-time Pro Bowl cornerback Jalen Ramsey from the physically unable to perform list on Monday. Ramsey, 31, sustained a knee injury during the team's minicamp but did not require surgery. Also cleared to return to the practice field is rookie offensive lineman Max Iheanachor, the first-round pick who has been sidelined since sustaining a neck/shoulder injury on Aug. 6. Ramsey was dealt to Pittsburgh last summer in a swap that sent safety Minkah Fitzpatrick back to Miami. He recorded 88 tackles, three sacks and one interception in 17 regular-season games with the Steelers. He has totaled 622 tackles and 25 interceptions in 152 career regular-season games (151 starts) with the Jacksonville Jaguars (2016-19), Los Angeles Rams (2019-22), Dolphins (2023-24) and Steelers since being drafted fifth overall in 2016. The Steelers play their final preseason game Thursday night at Buffalo and open the regular season at home against Atlanta on Sept. 13. --Field Level Media

item.title: La "guerre de Trump" à l'origine de la flambée des taux obligataires - ministre allemand
item.description: La récente flambée des taux obligataires est le résultat de "la guerre menée par le président américain Donald Trump en Iran", a déclaré lundi le ministre allemand des Finances Lars Klingbeil, lors d'une conférence de presse à Schaan, au Liechtenstein.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La récente flambée des taux obligataires est le résultat de "la guerre menée par le président américain Donald Trump en Iran", a déclaré lundi le ministre allemand des Finances Lars Klingbeil, lors d'une conférence de presse à Schaan, au Liechtenstein. "La hausse des taux d'intérêt observée ces derniers jours et ces dernières semaines est le résultat de l'incertitude mondiale déclenchée par la guerre de Donald Trump contre l'Iran", a-t-il déclaré aux côtés des ministres des Finances d'autres pays germanophones. Le rendement de l'obligation d'État allemande à 30 ans a atteint la semaine dernière son plus haut niveau depuis 2011, à 3,79%, en raison notamment des craintes d'inflation entretenues par l'impasse prolongée au Moyen-Orient, où les Etats-Unis et Israël ont déclenché une guerre contre l'Iran le 28 février. En guise de représailles à cette attaque, l'Iran avait rapidement fermé de facto le détroit d'Ormuz, voie essentielle au transport maritime mondiale d'hydrocarbures. Ceci s'était traduit par une flambée des cours du pétrole, qui restent à un niveau élevé, à plus de 90 dollars le baril, en raison de l'absence de tout progrès vers une résolution du conflit, les deux belligérants, qui clament tous deux contrôler le détroit d'Ormuz, brandissant au contraire la menace d'une escalade.

item.title: POINT MARCHÉS L'Europe termine sur une note prudente, en attendant des annonces américaines
item.description: Les Bourses européennes ont terminé en baisse mardi, dans l'attente de précisions de la part des États-Unis sur plusieurs catalyseurs aussi bien géopolitiques que macroéconomiques.
item.dc:creator: Coralie Lamarque
item.content:encoded: Les Bourses européennes ont terminé en baisse mardi, dans l'attente de précisions de la part des États-Unis sur plusieurs catalyseurs aussi bien géopolitiques que macroéconomiques. À Paris, le CAC 40 (.FCHI) a perdu 0,37% à 8.453,01 points. À Francfort, le Dax (.GDAXI) a reculé de 0,11% tandis qu'à Londres, le FTSE 100 (.FTSE) a pris 0,35%. L'indice EuroStoxx 50 (.STOXX50E) a reculé de de 0,22%, le FTSEurofirst 300 (.FTEU3) a grappillé 0,03%, tandis que le Stoxx 600 (.STOXX) a terminé stable. Le conflit entre l'Iran et les États-Unis continue de tenir en haleine les marchés, les investisseurs se tenant prêts pour la conférence de presse prévue à 17h00 GMT du secrétaire américain au Trésor, Scott Bessent, au sujet de nouvelles sanctions américaines contre l'Iran et dites sans précédent. Ces annonces pourraient jeter une ombre de plus sur les perspectives pétrolières et inflationnistes des marchés, en amont du discours du président de la Réserve fédérale américaine, Kevin Warsh, lors de la conférence de Jackson Hole qui débute cette semaine, qui [USN:L6N44L0DY TEXT:"suscitera"] également l'intérêt des opérateurs. En plus du Moyen-Orient et de la politique monétaire, les yeux des investisseurs restent rivés sur Washington, le président américain Donald Trump menaçant d'imposer des droits de douane de 50% sur les véhicules produits au Canada. VALEURS Lanterne rouge du CAC 40, Stellantis a perdu 4,41%, alors que la [USN:L6N44L0QL TEXT:"menace"] du président américain Donald Trump de porter à 50% les droits de douane sur les véhicules produits au Canada nuit aux grands groupes automobiles. Dans le sillage de nouvelles sanctions américaines prévues contre l'Iran, le compartiment des énergies fossiles (.SXEP) a perdu 1,57%, enregistrant de loin la pire performance sectorielle de la séance. À WALL STREET À l'heure de la clôture en Europe, le Dow Jones (.DJI) avance de 0,42%, tandis que le Standard & Poor's 500 (.SPX) cède 0,09% et que le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) recule de 0,36%. CHANGES Le billet vert progresse après avoir enregistré sa troisième baisse hebdomadaire sur les quatre dernières semaines, alors que le Trésor américain s'est engagé à racheter davantage d'obligations à long terme et que l'incertitude concernant de nouvelles sanctions américaines contre l'Iran bénéficie aux valeurs refuge. Le dollar gagne 0,18% face à un panier de devises de référence (.DXY) , tandis que l'euro perd 0,11% à 1,1666 dollar . TAUX Alors que le média CNBC a rapporté que le Trésor américain pourrait puiser dans son compte de trésorerie pour financer une augmentation des rachats de dette, le rendement des Treasuries à dix ans perd 3,8 points de base à 4,7001%, tandis que le deux ans grappille 0,6 point de base à 4,2401%. En Europe, le rendement du Bund allemand à dix ans a pris 0,7 point de base à 3,2532% et le deux ans a progressé de 0,9 point de base à 2,8632%. PÉTROLE Les cours pétroliers sont en baisse, sur fond de prises de bénéfices après les récentes hausses et avant des précisions sur les nouvelles sanctions américaines attendues contre l'Iran, qui pourraient perturber davantage les approvisionnements en provenance du Moyen-Orient. Le Brent perd 2,09% à 92,40 dollars le baril et le brut léger américain (West Texas Intermediate, WTI) lâche 2,65% à 84,75 dollars. item.title: Japan did not ban mosques - its constitution guarantees religious freedom
item.description: Online posts saying Japan has introduced “anti-Islam laws” that ban mosques, burqas, halal food and the Islamic call to prayer are false. The government has not brought in any such laws and Japan's constitution guarantees religious freedom.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Online posts saying Japan has introduced “anti-Islam laws” that ban mosques, burqas, halal food and the Islamic call to prayer are false. The government has not brought in any such laws and Japan's constitution guarantees religious freedom. Here are the key details: The posts from August said the so-called laws were “basically saying Islam is not welcome” in Japan. A spokesperson for Japan’s Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology told Reuters that was “not true at all”. The spokesperson said religious freedom is enshrined in Japan’s constitution and that no regulations have been introduced to purposely prohibit halal food, mosques, burqas or the call to prayer. Article 20 of the Constitution of Japan says: “Freedom of religion is guaranteed to all.” Mosques are mostly found in Japan’s larger cities, according to the J apanese National Tourism Organization , which recommends a mosque-finder website on its website. The JNTO says there has been a boost in “halal travel” to Japan and attributes that to an increase in Muslim-friendly and halal-accredited restaurants and facilities, mosques and tours. Verdict: False. Japan’s constitution guarantees religious freedom for all. A culture ministry spokesperson said there are no regulations that prohibit the practices listed in the online posts. This article was produced by the Reuters Fact Check team. Read more  about our fact-checking work.

item.title: Iraq's Australian coach Arnold renews contract for six months
item.description: Iraq's Australian coach Graham Arnold has renewed his contract with the team until 2027, the country's FA said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Ahmad Elghannam
item.content:encoded: Iraq's Australian coach Graham Arnold has renewed his contract with the team until 2027, the country's FA said on Monday. After weeks of speculation, the IFA made the announcement at a press conference attended by the 63-year-old, confirming he would remain in charge through the Gulf Cup in Saudi Arabia in September, as well as the Asian Cup early next year. "I have renewed my contract for six months and this decision is in my best interest and in the best interest of the Iraq national team, although the association offered me a four-year extension," Arnold was quoted as saying by the Iraqi News Agency. Arnold guided Iraq to this year's World Cup in the United States, Canada and Mexico, ending a 40-year absence from the tournament. However, Iraq exited at the group stage after losing all of their Group I matches against Norway, France and Senegal.

item.title: Gang attack on hillside town near Haiti's capital leaves 30 dead
item.description: At least 30 people were killed in a gang raid in the neighborhood of Kenscoff near Haiti's capital of Port-au-Prince, Kenscoff's mayor Jean Massillon told Reuters on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: At least 30 people were killed in a gang raid in the neighborhood of Kenscoff near Haiti's capital of Port-au-Prince, Kenscoff's mayor Jean Massillon told Reuters on Monday. Kenscoff is a hillside town overlooking Port-au-Prince has seen frequent gang attacks over the last couple of years. Rights groups have reported mass killings, rapes, arson and kidnappings, forcing thousands to flee their homes. Haitian rights group RNDDH estimated 30 to 40 people had been killed and 15 to 20 wounded in the overnight raid, which began around 10:30 p.m. local time (0230 GMT), but warned it was still difficult to assess a complete tally. Haiti's prime minister's office on Monday afternoon decried the "heinous attack", noting all security forces were on high alert and reinforcements were being deployed. "Kenscoff will not be abandoned," it said in a statement. "The government's authority will be restored, without weakness and without delay, throughout all of Kenscoff." Haiti's national police did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The community occupies a strategic position overlooking routes into Petion-Ville - home to several embassies, upscale hotels and the temporary seat of government - as well as routes from the capital into southern parts of the country. Local media said several houses were set on fire, including the home of Jean William Pape, a leading public health expert in Haiti. The attack occurred as the U.N.-backed Gang Suppression Force, which is mandated to help police fight gangs and replace an underfunded and ineffectual predecessor, plans to reach a full capacity of more than 5,500 troops by fall this year.

item.title: 49ers owner Jed York pleads no contest after arrest in Ohio
item.description: San Francisco 49ers owner Jed York pleaded no contest to reduced charges in Ohio on Monday after reaching an agreement with prosecutors following his Sunday arrest on suspicion of engaging in prostitution.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: San Francisco 49ers owner Jed York pleaded no contest to reduced charges in Ohio on Monday after reaching an agreement with prosecutors following his Sunday arrest on suspicion of engaging in prostitution. In a plea deal entered Monday, prosecutors amended the original charge to misdemeanor disorderly conduct and possessing criminal tools. According to reports, the criminal tool in York's possession was believed to be a cell phone used to reply to a prostitution advertisement. York, 46, was arrested in East Palestine. Court documents indicate agents for the Mahoning Valley Human Trafficking Task Force intercepted communication in which York responded to a prostitution website. York, like other NFL owners, is subject to the league's personal conduct policy. The NFL had not commented on the matter as of Monday afternoon. As part of the reduced charges, York was sentenced to one day in the Columbiana County Jail for each count. He was credited with time served Sunday and paid a fine of $1,150, according to court records. York, a native of Youngstown, Ohio, has been CEO of the 49ers since December 2008 and the team's principal owner since 2024. --Field Level Media

item.title: Canada to spend C$11 billion to build six new icebreakers, Carney says
item.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said on Monday the federal government would invest more than C$11 billion ($7.95 billion) to build six new icebreakers for the Canadian Coast Guard.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said on Monday the federal government would invest more than C$11 billion ($7.95 billion) to build six new icebreakers for the Canadian Coast Guard. Speaking in Levis, Quebec, Carney said the ships would be built by Quebec shipbuilder Chantier Davie and would replace the Coast Guard's aging heavy and medium icebreakers. After Russia, Canada has the world's second-largest fleet of icebreakers , which routinely escort U.S. ships heading to the Arctic. Carney has [USN:L1N4000V1 TEXT:"previously pledged "]to ensure Canada has the ability to protect its vast Arctic without relying on any other country. ($1 = 1.3832 Canadian dollars)

item.title: Mark Carney sensibly avoids stepping in fertilizer
item.description: Canada's prime minister rejected the latest US trade proposal, prompting fresh tariff talk. Ontario also wants exports like potash and oil cut off, which would seriously escalate the clash. Waiting out President Trump while pursuing more deals in Asia and beyond is better policy.
item.dc:creator: Gabriel Rubin
item.content:encoded: The United States and its neighbor to the north will share the longest land-border in the world even after President Donald Trump leaves office in 2029. It's an immutable restraint on Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney's leverage in a [USN:L1N44J034 TEXT:"trade war"], but also a lasting benefit. After rejecting the latest U.S. proposal, plodding patience is shrewder than extreme pressure. The White House, naturally, responded to the weekend's breakdown in negotiations with 50% tariffs on $20 billion of Canadian goods. Carney, who called U.S. demands "uneconomic" and "unfair" vowed to return the favor "dollar for dollar," prompting Trump to threaten to extend 50% tariffs onto all of the country's inbound cars, trucks and automotive parts. In Carney's interpretation, Trump wants to restrict Canada's ability to trade with other countries and unspecified demands related to Canadian culture, language and sovereignty. U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said Canada may have rejected the deal “perhaps for political reasons.” Canada has a nuclear option, one that leaders in Ontario and other provinces are ready to trigger. They want to cut off U.S. access to fertilizer and energy from the Great White North. About 85% of U.S. potash, essential in farming, comes from Canada, as does about 4 million barrels of oil daily, 60% of U.S. imports. Doing so would make it clearer that dependencies go both ways and heap additional economic pressure on Trump. The risks are greater than the rewards, however. Commodities, in particular, depend on supplier reliability. Once new providers are found, the business doesn’t tend to come back. U.S. [USN:L6N3WB0VG TEXT:"soybeans"] are instructive. Once they became leverage in the trade war with China, purchase agreements for U.S. farmers dried up. Even after a truce was struck, Beijing agreed to buy just 12 million metric tons from the United States last year, less than half as many as in 2024. Slow and steady is the better approach. Carney has good reasons to snub any limitations on Canada’s ability to trade unfettered with other countries. His top job is to dilute the 70% U.S. share of exports, as he has been doing with energy in India, China, and the EU. Carney's popularity at home affords him time and political capital, while Trump's mid-30s approval rating as midterm elections approach boosts the chances for U.S. policy revisions. There's no reason to step in fertilizer. Follow Gabriel Rubin on Bluesky and LinkedIn . Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on August 22 rejected a U.S. trade proposal, saying it was "a bad deal." U.S. President Donald Trump responded by imposing 50% tariffs on some Canadian goods, with Carney vowing to retaliate "dollar for dollar." Trump subsequently warned on August 24 that U.S. tariffs on all Canadian cars, trucks and automotive parts would be increased to 50% starting on January 1. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: Japan eyes tax breaks for non-core business sales in governance reform push, sources say
item.description: Japan's government is considering tax breaks on gains from sales of non-core businesses, a move that could accelerate long-delayed corporate restructuring and spur industry consolidation, two people with knowledge of the matter said.
item.dc:creator: Makiko Yamazaki, Miho Uranaka
item.content:encoded: Japan's government is considering tax breaks on gains from sales of non-core businesses, a move that could accelerate long-delayed corporate restructuring and spur industry consolidation, two people with knowledge of the matter said. The plan would remove a major obstacle to companies shedding non-core businesses and redeploying capital into growth areas, in what could become one of Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's most significant initiatives to advance corporate governance reform. Under the plan, roughly 30% corporate tax on gains from sales of non-core businesses would be deferred indefinitely, provided companies reinvest the proceeds within several years in acquisitions aligned with their core operations and commit to investing in those businesses, one of the sources said. The proposal is expected to be submitted as part of tax reform requests due at the end of this month, with details to be worked out before a final tax reform package for the next fiscal year is approved at year-end, said one of the sources, who declined to be identified as the matter is still private. POOR CAPITAL ALLOCATION The initiative is modelled on Germany's tax reform in the early 2000s, which largely exempted corporations from taxes on gains from share disposals, helping dismantle the country's dense network of cross-shareholdings and making it easier for companies to reshape their business portfolios. Non-core businesses often remain trapped within sprawling Japanese conglomerates because gains from divestitures are taxed, reducing the incentive to transfer assets to owners better positioned to extract value from them. The result is often inefficient capital allocation. A recent government study found that about 65% of Japanese companies' invested capital remains tied up in businesses that fail to earn their cost of capital, largely offsetting value created by higher-performing units. Such capital trapped in low-return operations is seen as limiting growth investment and weighing on long-term corporate value. Japan has already introduced a range of measures to promote business overhauls over the years, including spin-off tax rules in 2017 and a partial spin-off regime in 2023, but business divestitures taking advantage of those rules have remained relatively limited. A 2020 industry ministry report showed Japanese companies often lack clear divestment criteria and have traditionally prioritised maintaining group size, employment and corporate stability over portfolio reshaping. The tax reform, if implemented, is likely to boost already sizzling M&A activity in Japan. Deal activity involving Japanese companies last year more than doubled from the previous year to a record $353 billion, according to LSEG. Divestitures of Japanese businesses accounted for $44.7 billion of that total.

item.title: Vuelta third stage abandoned after hailstorm in Pyrenees
item.description: A torrential hailstorm in the French Pyrenees forced the abandonment of the third stage of the Vuelta a Espana on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A torrential hailstorm in the French Pyrenees forced the abandonment of the third stage of the Vuelta a Espana on Monday. With 15 km (9.32 miles) remaining of the 174-km route from Gruissan to Font-Romeu, the skies darkened as the peloton neared the top of the Col de Mont-Louis and huge hailstones began bouncing off the tarmac and pelting the riders. Mats Wenzel (Kern Pharma) and Lorenzo Fortunato (XDS Astana) were 25 seconds ahead of the peloton when the elements intervened as race leader and favourite Tadej Pogacar was seen indicating to the peloton to pull off the course. Bedraggled riders were then seen getting off their bikes and shuffling into a hotel for shelter. Shortly afterwards race organisers ASO announced the stage would not resume, leaving fans frustrated at the finish where thick layers of hail blanketed the road. Slovenia's Pogacar (UAE Emirates-XRG) retained his overall lead of nine seconds from Belgium's Wout van Aert (Dutch Visma-Lease a Bike) with Britain's Matt Brennan 10 seconds back. Earlier it had been warm and sunny on the flat approaches to the mountainous finish with no sign of the chaos to come as a five-man breakaway group stayed out ahead. Pogacar, bidding to complete his Grand Tour collection by winning the Vuelta for the first time, was always near the front of the pack with his team setting the pace. Sadly, his expected challenge for the stage victory fell foul of the weather in an anti-climactic finish. He will get his chance to underline his superiority again on Tuesday though with stage four featuring three first-category climbs as the race starts and finishes in Andorra la Vella.

item.title: Browns to open season with Deshaun Watson as QB1
item.description: New Browns head coach Todd Monken opted to stay the course in Cleveland and will start Deshaun Watson at quarterback in Week 1 of the regular season.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: New Browns head coach Todd Monken opted to stay the course in Cleveland and will start Deshaun Watson at quarterback in Week 1 of the regular season. "Took in the full body of work over the course of offseason to training camp to the games and the joint practice, and ultimately, felt like to start the season on the road, Deshaun gave us the best chance to move the ball and score points," Monken said Monday. "And that's really what it's about. I felt that way going into the last game, but wasn't sure. And after we talked as a staff and after we re-looked at everything, we're going to let it rip." Watson and Shedeur Sanders competed for the starting job in training camp, rotating reps with the first-team offense in practice and preseason games. The Browns begin the 2026 regular season with two road games: Sept. 13 at the Jacksonville Jaguars and the following week at Tampa Bay. Cleveland's first home game is Sept. 27 against the Carolina Panthers. Despite reports the Browns were considering holding Sanders in the backup role until the home opener, Monken said Monday he's not entering into a "week-to-week thing" and expects Watson to excel. "Again, I think Shedeur has done a great job, come a long ways, and we're excited about his future. But this is not a week-to-week decision," he said. Cleveland covets stability at the position, and Watson was viewed as the potential answer when he was acquired from the Houston Texans prior to the 2022 season. As part of the trade, Watson signed a five-year, $230 million contract. But after starting his tenure with the team serving a suspension, he has been hindered by injuries and is just 9-10 as a starter in Cleveland. He hasn't played more than seven games in any of his four seasons with the Browns. Watson did not play last season while recovering from two surgeries to repair his Achilles. Watson tore his right Achilles tendon in October 2024 and a recurrence of the same injury during rehab prompted a second operation. Sanders, a fifth-round pick in 2025, was thrown into the lineup as a rookie. With Watson on injured reserve all season, the Browns began the season with Joe Flacco as the starter but traded him to the Cincinnati Bengals. Dillon Gabriel, a third-round rookie in 2025, was named the starter but Sanders took over in November. He had seven touchdown passes and 10 interceptions in eight games. Watson likely needs a strong start to the regular season to win back a fan base that appears to be running out of patience. Watson was showered with boos by home fans during Saturday's preseason game and said it was "personal." He played the second half against Buffalo and completed 5 of 12 passes for 36 yards and an interception "It's a little bit (more) personal than that. So I think it's a disrespectful thing," Watson said of being booed at home. "So yeah, I mean, I'm going to keep whatever I feel with me and my family internally on how I feel about that. And yeah, just move on." Watson turns 31 the day after the Week 1 opener. Monken, hired to replace Kevin Stefanski, is a first-time head coach after serving as the Baltimore Ravens' offensive coordinator for the last three seasons. He said Watson and the Browns can avoid being booed at home by playing better, but also offered his perspective on Watson's response. "I see the competitor in him. I see the everyday work he puts in, and he wants to be back," Monken said. "He wants to get back to where he was as best he can, and that's hard. And again, I think the moment just got him after the game, and it can get all of us." --Field Level Media

item.title: Mexico's Sheinbaum says return to post of governor facing U.S. drug charges was 'not appropriate'
item.description: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said on Monday it was "reckless" and "not appropriate" for Sinaloa Governor Ruben Rocha Moya to return to his post while facing a domestic investigation following U.S. drug trafficking allegations.
item.dc:creator: Raul Cortes, Natalia Siniawski
item.content:encoded: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said on Monday it was "reckless" and "not appropriate" for Sinaloa Governor Ruben Rocha Moya to return to his post while facing a domestic investigation following U.S. drug trafficking allegations. Rocha, 77, a member of the ruling Morena party, dramatically [USN:L1N44I0K2 TEXT:"returned to office"] on Friday but [USN:L1N44K005 TEXT:"backtracked"] on Saturday following sharp backlash from Sheinbaum and others. Sheinbaum has trod carefully around the explosive allegations against Rocha. While rejecting a U.S. extradition request as lacking sufficient evidence, she has backed a Mexican investigation into the governor and hinted that his push to return to office was driven by self-interest. U.S. prosecutors charged Rocha in April with conspiring with the Sinaloa Cartel to traffic drugs into the United States in exchange for bribes and political support. Rocha is the first sitting governor in Mexico to face drug trafficking charges by the U.S. Rocha has denied the charges, calling them a politically motivated attack. He stepped down for three months before announcing on X on Friday that he had resumed power with a "clear conscience" and his "head held high." "I had no prior knowledge that he wanted to return," Sheinbaum said at her daily morning press conference on Monday. "I don't know what led the governor — who is once again on leave — to return," Sheinbaum added. "I haven't spoken to him, nor do I intend to." The Sinaloa state congress is expected to appoint an interim governor this week.

item.title: Former world champion Dott convicted of historical sexual abuse
item.description: Former snooker world champion Graeme Dott was on Monday convicted of sexually abusing two children several decades ago after a trial in a Scottish court.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Former snooker world champion Graeme Dott was on Monday convicted of sexually abusing two children several decades ago after a trial in a Scottish court. Dott was charged with two counts of "lewd, indecent and libidinous behaviour", against a girl between 1993 and 1996, and a boy between 2006 and 2010. The indictment alleged that the 49-year-old had sexually assaulted the girl, exposed himself to her and induced her to touch him. Dott was also accused of making sexual remarks to the boy and touching his genitals. He denied the charges but was found guilty after a trial at the High Court in Glasgow. He will be sentenced next month. "Dott is a dangerous individual and I hope this conviction provides some measure of comfort to those impacted by his crimes," Detective Inspector Gary Smillie from Police Scotland told reporters. Dott won the world snooker championship in 2006, beating Peter Ebdon 18-14 in the final, and twice finished as runner-up in 2004 and 2010. He was suspended by the World Professional Billiards and Snooker Association after the charges were announced last year.

item.title: As US border reopens to Mexican cattle, concerns persist over screwworm spread
item.description: Mexico is bolstering its screwworm containment campaign in northern border states where recent cases have been detected, heightening scrutiny of livestock exports as cross-border trade resumed on Monday under a phased U.S. reopening.
item.dc:creator: Cassandra Garrison, Leah Douglas
item.content:encoded: Mexico is bolstering its screwworm containment campaign in northern border states where recent cases have been detected, heightening scrutiny of livestock exports as cross-border trade resumed on Monday under a phased U.S. reopening. Mexican Agriculture Minister Columba Lopez said authorities would reinforce the dispersal of sterile flies in Sonora and Chihuahua, a key eradication strategy aimed at preventing the parasite from reproducing. The phased reopening marks the first easing of a U.S. ban imposed more than a year ago to keep out the flesh-eating pest, with imports set [USN:FWN43Q0OT TEXT:"to resume"] initially through Arizona before expanding to additional ports in New Mexico. The plan has drawn criticism from some U.S. cattle groups and state officials who argue that resuming imports could increase screwworm risks even as the parasite continues to spread in northern Mexico and has already been detected in Texas and New Mexico. The USDA previously said the reopening would proceed in phases and remain contingent on Mexico's compliance with screwworm-control measures. A USDA website on Monday said it reopened the Douglas, Arizona, port to cattle imports from Mexico "guided by overlapping safeguards and a science-based import protocol" agreed upon by the two countries. The USDA will next evaluate the reopening of ports in Santa Teresa and Columbus, New Mexico to cattle, bison, and horses. "The opening of ports may be paused if USDA identifies increased risk in Sonora or Chihuahua via post-opening audits or other observations/information," the site said. Chihuahua, one of Mexico's most important cattle-exporting states, has reported 183 confirmed screwworm cases since detecting its first case in July, while neighboring Sonora state has reported two confirmed cases after announcing its first detection last week. Sonora has activated emergency surveillance and containment protocols, while Chihuahua has intensified inspections, livestock movement controls and treatment campaigns to prevent further spread. The sterile insect technique works by releasing millions of sterilized screwworm flies that mate with wild females but produce no offspring, gradually driving down the pest population. Mexico recently opened a sterile-fly production plant in Chiapas, while the United States is building its own production facility in Texas, expected to be completed by [USN:L6N4470WS TEXT:"spring of 2027"]. Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum referred to the sterile fly technique as a "modern" and "effective" way to fight screwworm. "That allows us to open the border," Sheibaum said in her daily press conference.

item.title: A medida que la frontera de EEUU vuelve a abrirse al ganado mexicano, persiste preocupación por propagación del gusano barrenador
item.description: México está intensificando su campaña de contención de la mosca del gusano barrenador en los estados fronterizos del norte, donde se han detectado casos recientes, lo que ha llevado a un mayor control de las exportaciones de ganado ahora que el comercio transfronterizo se reanuda el lunes en el marco de la reapertura gradual de Estados Unidos.
item.dc:creator: Cassandra Garrison, Leah Douglas
item.content:encoded: México está intensificando su campaña de contención de la mosca del gusano barrenador en los estados fronterizos del norte, donde se han detectado casos recientes, lo que ha llevado a un mayor control de las exportaciones de ganado ahora que el comercio transfronterizo se reanuda el lunes en el marco de la reapertura gradual de Estados Unidos. La secretaria de Agricultura de México, Columba López, afirmó que las autoridades reforzarían la liberación de moscas estériles en Sonora y Chihuahua, una estrategia clave de erradicación destinada a impedir que el parásito se reproduzca. "Vamos a mantener nosotros todo el sistema de trazabilidad desde la nacencia hasta que coloquemos el ganado del otro lado", dijo López en un enlace desde Sonora a la conferencia de prensa matutina de la presidente Claudia Sheinbaum. "Y la otra parte es reforzar la dispersión de moscas (vamos a) mantener muchísimos controles de seguridad", añadió. La planeada reapertura gradual supone la primera flexibilización de[USN:L6N43Q1B0 TEXT:" la prohibición impuesta"] por Estados Unidos hace más de un año para impedir la entrada de esta plaga carnívora; está previsto que las importaciones se reanuden inicialmente a través de Arizona, antes de ampliarse a otros puertos de Nuevo México. El plan ha suscitado críticas por parte de algunas asociaciones ganaderas estadounidenses y de funcionarios estatales, que argumentan que la reanudación de las importaciones podría aumentar el riesgo de la mosca, incluso cuando el parásito sigue propagándose en el norte de México y ya se ha detectado en Texas y Nuevo México. El Departamento de Agricultura de Estados Unidos (USDA por su sigla en inglés) había indicado anteriormente que la reapertura se llevaría a cabo por fases y que seguiría dependiendo del cumplimiento por parte de México de las medidas de control de la mosca del gusano. El lunes, la página en internet del USDA seguía indicando que todos los puertos de entrada del sur permanecían cerrados al comercio de ganado. La agencia no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud para aclarar la situación respecto a la reapertura. Chihuahua, uno de los estados mexicanos más importantes en la exportación de ganado, ha notificado 183 casos confirmados de gusano barrenador desde que detectó su primer caso en julio, mientras que el vecino estado Sonora ha notificado dos casos confirmados tras anunciar su primera detección la semana pasada. Sonora ha activado protocolos de vigilancia y contención de emergencia, mientras que Chihuahua ha intensificado las inspecciones, los controles de movimiento de ganado y las campañas de tratamiento para evitar una mayor propagación. La técnica de insectos estériles consiste en liberar millones de moscas esterilizadas que se aparean con hembras silvestres pero no producen descendencia, lo que reduce gradualmente la población de la plaga. México ha inaugurado recientemente una planta de producción de moscas estériles en Chiapas, mientras que Estados Unidos está construyendo su propia instalación de producción en Texas, cuya finalización está prevista para la primavera de 2027. La presidenta Sheinbaum se refirió a la técnica de la mosca estéril como una forma "moderna" y "eficaz" de combatir al gusano barrenador. "Eso nos permite que se abra la frontera", afirmó la mandataria en su rueda de prensa.

item.title: EEUU anuncia "Día D económico" contra Irán con ampliación de sanciones secundarias
item.description: El Gobierno de Donald Trump anunció el lunes una ampliación de las sanciones secundarias que puede imponer a entidades y países que mantienen vínculos comerciales con Irán en todo el mundo, mientras intensifica significativamente la presión económica sobre Teherán a medida que la guerra se acerca a su sexto mes.
item.dc:creator: David Lawder, Humeyra Pamuk
item.content:encoded: El Gobierno de Donald Trump anunció el lunes una ampliación de las sanciones secundarias que puede imponer a entidades y países que mantienen vínculos comerciales con Irán en todo el mundo, mientras intensifica significativamente la presión económica sobre Teherán a medida que la guerra se acerca a su sexto mes. En una conferencia de prensa, el secretario del Tesoro, Scott Bessent, presentó lo que describió como un "Día D económico", con el objetivo de dar una advertencia final a los países para que rompan sus vínculos comerciales con Irán o se arriesguen a que empresas y entidades clave queden excluidas del sistema financiero basado en el dólar. "Estamos lanzando una ofensiva económica contra las conexiones financieras de Irán en todo el mundo. Nuestro objetivo es cortar todo el sustento económico que sostiene a este régimen tiránico hasta que Teherán se quede solo", declaró Bessent. El Departamento del Tesoro ha mapeado las redes, los facilitadores y los canales financieros que Irán utiliza para el contrabando de petróleo y la evasión de sanciones, y afirmó que Washington trabajará con sus socios para atacar cualquier fuente de "ingresos ilícitos" de Irán. El Departamento de Estado anunció que ha emitido resoluciones contra cinco sectores -activos digitales, tecnología, oro, aviación y transporte marítimo- que el gobierno iraní utiliza para apuntalar su economía. El Tesoro también ha impuesto sanciones a casi 60 entidades, personas y buques. Durante varios años, China ha sido el mayor comprador de petróleo iraní, y Washington ha intensificado sus esfuerzos para restringir las compras chinas, aunque hasta el momento no ha designado a los grandes bancos chinos que podrían estar facilitando el comercio de petróleo. La guerra de Trump con Irán, que ha disparado los precios de la energía a nivel mundial, está a punto de cumplir seis meses. Si bien los intensos combates han disminuido, los esfuerzos diplomáticos para poner fin a la guerra se han estancado y el transporte de petróleo y materias primas a través del estrecho de Ormuz permanece bloqueado, lo que mantiene elevados los precios de la energía. El índice de aprobación de Trump ha caído a mínimos históricos, y solo el 33% de los estadounidenses aprueba su gestión, según la última encuesta de Reuters/Ipsos. El mandatario afirma que los costos económicos son necesarios para garantizar que Irán no posea armas nucleares. Estados Unidos lleva décadas manteniendo sanciones contra Irán, en su mayoría para reducir sus ingresos petroleros, limitar el sector de la aviación, las criptomonedas, la adquisición de componentes de armas y otro material militar. También busca cortar la financiación a las empresas controladas por el Cuerpo de la Guardia Revolucionaria Islámica, una fuerza dominante en la economía iraní. Las sanciones excluyen a las entidades designadas del sistema financiero basado en el dólar, pero Teherán ha logrado crear rápidamente nuevas empresas pantalla, otras entidades y matrículas de buques para eludir las sanciones.

item.title: Italy's banking shake-up: all the M&A deals since 2025
item.description: Monte dei Paschi di Siena's simultaneous offers for Banco BPM and Banca Generali are the latest in a series of moves seeking to transform Italy's once-dormant banking sector.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Monte dei Paschi di Siena's (BMPS.MI) simultaneous offers for Banco BPM (BAMI.MI) and Banca Generali (BGN.MI) are the latest in a series of moves seeking to transform Italy's once-dormant banking sector. The offers, unveiled last week as part of MPS' efforts to repel a hostile takeover by Italy's largest bank Intesa Sanpaolo (ISP.MI) , would create the country's third largest banking group. Here is a rundown of all the other completed and attempted Italian banking sector M&A deals since the start of 2025. 1. MONTE DEI PASCHI DI SIENA (MPS) - BANCO BPM - BANCA GENERALI MPS launched on August 21 separate [USN:L1N44H0NA TEXT:"all-share bids"] totalling about €34 billion ($40 billion) for rival Banco BPM and Generali-controlled (GASI.MI) wealth manager Banca Generali. CEO Luigi Lovaglio said MPS was the "natural partner for a friendly aggregation" and promised combined annual pre-tax synergies of around €2.6 billion. However, given Intesa's previously announced bid, under Italian takeover rules at least two thirds of MPS shareholders will have to clear the plan, in a vote scheduled for October 29. Previously, Banco BPM had invited MPS to discuss "[USN:L1N43X13W TEXT:"a merger of equals"]", but ended talks last month after France's Credit Agricole , its largest investor with a 29.3% stake, expressed its disapproval. 2. INTESA SANPAOLO - MONTE DEI PASCHI DI SIENA (MPS) - UNIPOL - BPER Intesa's unsolicited €30.6 billion [USN:L4N42G0DE TEXT:"cash-and-share bid"] for smaller rival MPS would create the euro zone's second-largest lender, placing Italy's top bank behind Spain's Banco Santander (SAN.MC) in terms of market value. Under the deal, Intesa would sell to Unipol (UNPI.MI) about half of the MPS retail network it would receive through the takeover. The network would then be combined with Unipol-backed lender BPER Banca (EMII.MI) to create a bank that would operate under the Monte dei Paschi brand. 3. UNICREDIT - COMMERZBANK UniCredit (CRDI.MI) , which stayed out of Italian M&A deals after a failed swoop on Banco BPM, said in July it had increased its stake in [USN:L8N43A0H6 TEXT:"Commerzbank"] (CBKG.DE) to 47.6%, pursuing a takeover bid despite German resistance. When excluding treasury shares, which carry no voting rights, UniCredit has a 49.7% voting stake in the German lender. It could further hike its stake by amending swap contracts. UniCredit, the second-largest bank in Italy, approached Commerzbank about merger talks [USN:S8N3J3082 TEXT:"as early as September 2024"], after it bought a 9% in the German peer and signalled it was open to taking more. 4. CF+ - BANCA SISTEMA Elliott-backed speciality lender Banca CF+ completed in March a €145-million offer for rival Banca Sistema (BSTA.MI) . 5. MPS - MEDIOBANCA In September last year, MPS completed a €16-billion takeover of merchant bank Mediobanca, thus also becoming the main investor in insurer Generali, a coveted asset in Italian finance. The deal, coming from a bank bailed out by the government in 2017 and reprivatised in 2023-2024, turned MPS into a [USN:L2N3V90Q0 TEXT:"key M&A actor"]. 6. BANCA IFIS - ILLIMITY Venice-based IFIS (IF.MI) completed in August 2025 a €298-million cash-and-shares offer for Illimity, a digital bank founded by former industry minister and veteran banker Corrado Passera, which was later delisted from the Milan bourse. 7. BPER - BANCA POPOLARE DI SONDRIO Italy's fourth-largest bank in July 2025 completed a €5.4 billion cash-and-share offer for the smaller peer based in the northern city of Sondrio, calling it a defensive move dictated by the accelerating consolidation. Insurer Unipol, the main shareholder in both banks, played a pivotal role. 8. UNICREDIT - BANCO BPM Italy's second-biggest bank [USN:L8N3TJ0Y1 TEXT:"dropped"] its €15-billion all-share offer for Banco BPM in July 2025, blaming conditions the government had set to clear the deal. UniCredit had presented its bid in November 2024. 9. BANCO BPM - ANIMA HOLDING Shortly before UniCredit's failed takeover gambit, Banco BPM had bid to buy fund manager Anima Holding (ANIM.MI) , a €1.8 billion-euro acquisition it [USN:S8N3OK0C7 TEXT:"completed in April 2025"]. 10. MEDIOBANCA - BANCA GENERALI In an [USN:L8N3UD0BK TEXT:"unsuccessful attempt"] to thwart MPS' takeover bid, Mediobanca announced in April 2025 a €6.3-billion all-share offer for wealth manager Banca Generali (BGN.MI) . It failed to win shareholders' approval for it. 11. BANCA GENERALI - INTERMONTE Banca Generali completed in January 2025 a €98.2 million euro purchase of broker Intermonte, to boost its investment banking skills and complement its wealth management offer with corporate finance advisory services. ($1 = 0.8574 euros)

item.title: From Tokyo to London, heatwaves send men to work in shorts
item.description: Scorching summer temperatures have done what decades of dress-down Fridays have failed to do — get men to the office in shorts.
item.dc:creator: Agnieszka Olenska, Helen Reid, James Davey
item.content:encoded: Scorching summer temperatures have done what decades of dress-down Fridays have failed to do — get men to the office in shorts. Japan's capital led the way. This year the metropolitan government's long-standing no-tie, no-jacket [USN:L6N43H0CH TEXT:""Cool Biz""] campaign took a step further by encouraging its staff to ditch long trousers, and even try T-shirts and sneakers. As [USN:L8N44G0YD TEXT:"heatwaves mounted"] across Europe, other workers followed in Tokyo's wake, sometimes with the encouragement of authorities and management, sometimes without. LINE BETWEEN COMMUTER AND HOLIDAY STYLES BLURRING Major retailers told Reuters linen shorts and suits were flying off the shelves in Britain, as men opted for breathable fabrics more commonly associated with Mediterranean climes. "The lines between 'commuter' and 'holiday' style are blurring," Martha Hibberd, menswear buyer at British department store John Lewis, said. Marks and Spencer (MKS.L) said sales of men's linen trousers in June to July jumped 183% compared with the same period a year ago. H&M (HMb.ST) — one of Europe's biggest fashion retailers — said it was bringing in lighter clothes and delaying the release of autumnal lines to later in the year. "It looks like we're not going back when it comes to climate change," Andreas Lowenstam, H&M's head of menswear design, said. Hugo Boss said it has increased its assortment of tailored shorts. Its "Boss by Beckham" range in collaboration with soccer star David Beckham, offers a pair of cotton tailored shorts for €229 ($267.27). 'SHORTS ARE FOR WEEKENDS' The trend was there to see in Europe's business hubs, from London's Canary Wharf to the streets of Frankfurt. But there were some limits. At Norway's largest bank, DNB, staff were welcome to wear shorts and skirts, spokesperson Vidar Korsberg Dalsbo told Reuters. "However, we are probably talking about smarter garments with some length rather than a ballerina skirt or a cheeky pair of 1970s-style soccer shorts." In June, Gianfranco Lot, Switzerland head at insurance group Swiss Re (SRENH.S) , wrote an email to staff with tips on how to stay cool. Alongside the list of suggestions — such as drinking water, breaking when needed, and taking a dip in Lake Zurich just across from the office — there was a quick reminder that "shorts are for weekends". Pushing back against the traditions, there were signs that some workers were prepared to take a stand for their lighter attire. Germany's biggest union, IG Metall, and services sector union Verdi both told Reuters they believed dress codes should be relaxed or waived if necessary at times of higher temperatures. "Summers are getting hotter, heat waves are becoming more frequent, and the strain on workers is noticeably increasing," Moriz Tiedemann, occupational health expert at IG Metall, said. Some were already taking matters into their own hands. In Warsaw, one bus driver decided he had had enough of the standard uniform of long polyester trousers and turned up to work one day this month in a skirt, as a protest. "These materials make us sweat and overheat," said the man, who only gave his name as Darek.
